395/41.
POLICE
Gordon/Bood.
November 14th. 41.

Strike, Hong Chen (鴻章) Cotton spinning, weaving
and Dyeing Mill Co. Ltd., No. 381 Markham Road.
D.I. Smith, Officer in Charge. SRODA

Sir,

At 6.30 a.m. on the 14-11-41 a telephone message
was received from Mr. Chang Yeo Nan (鄭耀南) the
manager of the Hong Chen (鴻章) Spinning, Weaving
and Dyeing Mill Co. Ltd., No. 381 Markham Road, reporting
that the workers in the spinning and dyeing had a strike.
On 7th insth, 1938, about 319 attended
and except that on the evening of the 13-11-41 a
number of male workers employed in the dyeing department
started an agitation for an increase in wage of 50%
and betterment of working conditions. The agitation
spread to the spinning and weaving departments causing
a general unrest.

At 6 a.m. on the 14-11-41 the day shift refused
to start work and declared a "sit down" strike. They
were joined by the majority of the night shift which
resulted in approximately 2,000 workers loitering about
the various departments.

At 9 a.m. on the 14-11-41 negotiations were opened
between the management, the spinners and the weavers,
the dyers refused to take part as they stated they had
already despatched three representatives to the Social
Movement Direction Committee, 95/10 Edinburgh Road, to
request that organization to mediate for a settlement
of the strike.

The management offered the strikers an increase in
wages of 30% effective from the 1-11-41. These terms
were acceptable to the spinners but rejected by the
weavers.

（批：O.C. (Divisions) Information Kmh A.O.B）
（批：R.C. (Spl. Br.) I take it you will offer comment to A.J.P. re X）
（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER OF POLICE 14 NOV. 1941 (DIVISIONS)）
（批：h.g.11. X）

395/41。
警务处
戈登路。
1941年11月14日。

罢工，鸿章（鴻章）棉纺织印染有限公司，马克姆路381号。
督察史密斯，负责人。SRODA

先生：

1941年11月14日上午6时30分，接到马克姆路381号鸿章（鴻章）纺织印染有限公司经理郑耀南先生的电话报告，称纺纱和染色部门工人罢工。
1938年本月7日，约有319人参加，此外，1941年11月13日晚，染色部门的一些男工开始煽动要求加薪50%并改善工作条件。这一煽动蔓延至纺纱和织布部门，造成普遍的不安。

1941年11月14日上午6时，白班工人拒绝开工，并宣布进行“静坐”罢工。夜班大多数工人也加入其中，导致约2,000名工人在各个部门徘徊。

1941年11月14日上午9时，资方与纺纱工和织布工开始谈判，但染色工拒绝参加，因为他们声称已派遣三名代表前往爱丁堡路95/10号的社会运动指导委员会，请求该组织调解以解决罢工问题。

资方向罢工者提出自1941年11月1日起加薪30%。这些条件为纺纱工所接受，但被织布工拒绝。

（批：各区主管警官 信息 Kmh 其他事项）
（批：R.C. (特科) 我想你会就 X 向 A.J.P. 提供意见）
（印：警务处副总巡捕 1941年11月14日 (各区)）
（批：h.g.11. X）

page_data.en:
Misc. 395/41.

At 10a.m. on the 14-11-41 some 1,100 spinners
decided to resume work and returned to their respective
machines. However, at 10.30a.m. they stopped their
machines probably due to pressure from the workers of
the dyeing department.

On the 14-11-41 three representatives
from the Labour Conciliation Committee, named
as Mr. 許云甫, Mr. Tsang (王志武)
and Mr. 孔祥禧 respectively, visited the
factory and requested that they be allowed to mediate
in the dispute. The management, however, refused to
treat with them. They were informed by D.I. with
that they are functioning illegally and warned against
any recurrence.

As a result of further negotiations the spinners
and a number of dyers decided to start their machines
but they were prevented from working by agitators who
pulled a number of belts from the machine driving
wheels and switched off the motors.

The weavers and a section of the dyers were now
in a truculent mood. The weavers locked themselves
in the weaving department and refused to open the doors.
Some of them were smoking cigarettes thereby causing
grave danger of setting the factory on fire.

The dyers congregated at the far end of the dyeing
department and started to shout insults at the Police
who were in attendance. A number of these dyers had
armed themselves with sticks and iron bars.
page_data.zh:
杂项 395/41。

1941年11月14日上午10时，约1,100名纺纱工决定复工并回到各自的机器旁。然而，上午10时30分，他们停止了机器运转，可能是由于受到染色部门工人的压力。

1941年11月14日，来自劳工调解委员会的三名代表，分别名为许云甫、Tsang（王志武）先生和孔祥禧先生，访问了工厂，请求允许他们调解纠纷。然而，资方拒绝与他们交涉。督察告知他们，他们的活动是非法的，并警告不得再犯。

经过进一步谈判，纺纱工和部分染色工决定启动机器，但被滋事者阻止工作，这些滋事者从机器驱动轮上扯下多条皮带并关闭了电机。

织布工和部分染色工现在情绪暴躁。织布工将自己锁在织布部门内，拒绝开门。其中一些人在吸烟，从而造成了引发工厂火灾的严重危险。

染色工聚集在染色部门的远端，并开始对在场的警察高声辱骂。其中一些染色工手持棍棒和铁条武装自己。

page_data.en:
Misc. 395/41.

At 4.55 p.m. on the 14-11-41 the Reserve Unit
was called out by Chief Inspector Trodd.
Squads of Police operating under the directions
of Supt. Chamberlain cleared the spinning and dyeing
departments without untoward incidents, but before
access could be gained to the weaving department
C.D.C. 95 had to climb through a window and unbolt
a door.
When the Police entered this department which
contained approximately 900 females, they were pelted
with shuttles and wet bobbins and it was found
necessary to use batons to subdue the mob.
Three women sustained injuries, two of whom
received first aid treatment at the factory and the
third at St. Elizabeth's Hospital:-
(1) Wang Feng Ying (姚鳳英), 30 years, Anhwei,
D.B.C. "B" Div. Minor injuries to head.
(2) T'ang Chu Mei (朱根妹), 30 years, Anhwei,
Contusion of buttock.
Copy to Sp. Br.
(3) Tsung Hsiao Mei (張小妹), 24 years, Pootung,
Female, 27 Lung Ka Hong, Sinza Road,
Trauma of right leg. Detained in Hospital.
There were no Police casualties.
The factory was cleared and the mob dispersed
from the vicinity at 6.30 p.m. 14-11-41.
The factory will be closed until an amicable
settlement has been reached.
D.C. "B" and members of the Special Branch
attended.
J. Smith
D.S.I.
HFF/..
page_data.zh:
杂项 395/41。

1941年11月14日下午4时55分，预备队由总督察特罗德（Trodd）召集出动。
在张伯伦（Chamberlain）警司指挥下行动的警察小队清除了纺纱和染色部门，未发生不幸事件，但在进入织布部门之前，第95号华籍侦探长不得不爬过窗户并打开门栓。
当警察进入这个约有900名女工的部门时，他们遭到梭子和湿纱管的投掷，发现有必要使用警棍来制服暴徒。
三名妇女受伤，其中两人在工厂接受了急救治疗，第三人在圣伊丽莎白医院接受治疗：-
(1) 王凤英（姚鳳英），30岁，安徽，
“B”区侦探局。头部轻伤。
(2) 唐朱梅（朱根妹），30岁，安徽，
臀部挫伤。
抄送特科
(3) 宗小妹（張小妹），24岁，浦东，
女性，新闸路龙家洪27号，
右腿外伤。留院观察。
警方无伤亡。
工厂于1941年11月14日下午6时30分被清空，暴徒从附近驱散。
工厂将关闭，直至达成友好和解。
“B”区副主管警官及特科成员到场。
J. 史密斯
副督察
HFF/..

page_data.en:
Worker's Demands.

(1) An increase of 50% in wages be enforced.
(2) That the "cheap" rice be obtained not in excess of $80.00
per picul and every worker be given $2.00 daily for rice
allowance.
(3) That a special H.C.L. allowance of $1.00 be granted
(4) That ½ of a picul of cheap rice be supplied during each term.
(5) Wages and rice allowances be paid as usual on the occasion of
Sundays or holidays.
(6) That workers be not dismissed without cause.
(7) That workers be allowed to live in the two living
quarters supplied by the mill otherwise a daily house
rent should be paid to them.
page_data.zh:
工人要求。

(1) 强制执行加薪50%。
(2) “平价”米每担不超过80.00元，每位工人每天发放2.00元作为米贴。
(3) 给予特别住房津贴1.00元
(4) 每期供应半担平价米。
(5) 星期日或节假日照常支付工资和米贴。
(6) 不得无故解雇工人。
(7) 允许工人居住在工厂提供的两处宿舍内，否则应向他们支付每日房租。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. S. REGISTRY
Gordon Road D. 7543
19-11-41
November 15, 41.

Strike, Hong Chang Cotton Spinning, Weaving and Dyeing Mill
Co. Ltd., No. 381 Markham Road.
D.S.I. Smith, Eason Officer i/c.

Sir,

At 7.30 a.m. on the 15-11-41 one named Pah Chuen
Ming (白俊明), Mill Inspector, employed at the Hong
Chang (鸿章) Spinning, Weaving and Dyeing Mill Co. Ltd.,
No. 381 Markham Road, came to the station and reported
that at about 6.45 a.m. 15-11-41 whilst he was escorting
one named Dong Hung (唐衡仔), an overseer employed in the
weaving department, along Connaught Road near Medhurst
Road, they were held-up by about 100 male strikers who
seized and assaulted the overseer. However, the overseer
broke away from them and ran into the Nyi Lai (利来)
Cigarette and Exchange Shop, No. 19 Connaught Road, and
made good his escape via the rear door.

A number of the strikers rushed into the shop after
the fleeing overseer and broke two panes of glass on a
show-case and seven confectionery bottles estimated
value $250.00.

The overseer cannot identify his assailants. He
attended the Paulun Hospital for treatment and the
following doctor's certificate was issued:-

"Contusion of back and waist, and abrasion of
left leg."

The proprietor of the shop named Zee Koe Si (徐淦泉)
has been compensated for his loss by the management of
the factory.

A party of Police under S.I. Woschikoff attended
the scene but the strikers had already dispersed.

D.D.O. "B" Div.                                    J. Smith
Copy to -p. Br.                                    D.S.I.

1941年11月15日。

罢工，鸿章棉纺织印染有限公司，马克姆路381号。
副督察史密斯，Eason（音译）警官负责。

先生：

1941年11月15日上午7时30分，一名名为白俊明的工厂稽查员，受雇于马克姆路381号鸿章（鸿章）纺织印染有限公司，来到警署报告称，1941年11月15日上午6时45分左右，当他护送一名名为唐衡仔的织布部门监工沿康纳路靠近麦赫斯特路路段行走时，他们遭到约100名男罢工者的拦截，这些罢工者抓住并殴打了该监工。然而，该监工挣脱了他们，跑进康纳路19号的利来香烟兑换店，并从后门成功逃脱。

一些罢工者追赶逃跑的监工冲进店内，打碎了展示柜的两块玻璃和七个糖果瓶，估计价值250.00元。

该监工无法指认袭击者。他前往宝隆医院接受治疗，并出具了以下医生证明：-

“背部和腰部挫伤，左腿擦伤。”

店主徐淦泉先生的损失已由工厂管理层赔偿。

由沃什科夫（Woschikoff）巡佐率领的一队警察赶到现场，但罢工者已经散去。

“B”区副主管警官                                    J. 史密斯

Misc. 395/41.
Gordon Road
November 14th, 41.
Strike, Hong Chang (鴻章) Cotton Spinning, Weaving
and Dyeing Mill Co. Ltd., No. 381 Markham Road.
D.J.I. Smith. Officer in Charge: Strode

Sir,
At 6.50 a.m. on the 14-11-41 a telephone message
was received from Mr. Tsung Yao Nan (靳耀南) the
manager of the Hong Chang (鴻章) Spinning, Weaving
and Dyeing Mill Co. Ltd., No. 381 Markham Road, reporting
that the workers of the factory had declared a strike.
D.J.I. Smith, C.D... 128 and C.D.C. 319 attended
and ascertained that on the evening of the 13-11-41 a
number of male workers employed in the dyeing department
started an agitation for an increase in wages of 50%
and betterment of working conditions. The agitation
spread to the spinning and weaving departments causing
a general unrest.
At 6a.m. on the 14-11-41 the day shift refused
to start work and declared a "sit down" strike. They
were joined by the majority of the night shift which
resulted in approximately 2,000 workers loitering about
the various departments.
At 9a.m. on the 14-11-41 negotiations were opened
between the management, the spinners and the weavers,
the dyers refused to take part as they stated they had
already despatched three representatives to the Social
Movement Direction Committee, 95/10 Edinburgh Road, to
request that organization to mediate for a settlement
of the strike.
The management offered the strikers an increase in
wages of 30% effective from the 1-11-41. These terms
were acceptable to the spinners but rejected by the
weavers.

1941年11月14日。
鸿章棉纺织印染有限公司罢工，地址：马克姆路381号。
D.J.I. Smith。负责警官：Strode

先生，
1941年11月14日上午6时50分，接到马克姆路381号鸿章纺纱织布印染有限公司经理靳耀南（Tsung Yao Nan）先生的电话报告，称该厂工人已宣布罢工。
D.J.I. Smith、巡捕128号和副巡捕319号前往现场，查明1941年11月13日晚，染色部的一些男工发起骚动，要求增加工资50%并改善工作条件。骚动蔓延至纺纱部和织布部，引起普遍不安。
1941年11月14日上午6时，白班工人拒绝开工，并宣布实行“静坐”罢工。夜班大多数工人也加入其中，导致约2,000名工人在各个部门闲逛。
1941年11月14日上午9时，资方与纺纱工和织布工开始谈判，但染色工拒绝参加，因为他们声称已派遣三名代表前往爱丁堡路95/10号的社会运动指导委员会，请求该组织调解以解决罢工问题。
资方向罢工者提出自1941年11月1日起加薪30%的条件。这些条件为纺纱工所接受，但被织布工拒绝。

page_data.en:
Misc. 395/41.

At 10a.m. on the 14-11-41 some 1,100 spinners
decided to resume work and returned to their respective
machines. However, at 10.30a.m. they stopped their
machines probably due to pressure from the workers of
the other departments.

At 3 p.m. on the 14-11-41 three representatives
from the Social Movement Direction Committee, named
Lee Yuen Tch (許云甫), Wong Ts Woo (王志武)
and Kung Chiang I (孔祥禧) respectively, visited the
factory and requested that they be allowed to mediate
in the dispute. The management, however, refused to
treat with them. They were informed by D.I. Smith
that they were functioning illegally and warned against
any recurrence.

As a result of further negotiations the spinners
and a number of dyers decided to start their machines
but they were prevented from working by agitators who
pulled a number of belts from the machine driving
wheels and switched off the motors.

The weavers and a section of the dyers were now
in a truculent mood. The weavers locked themselves
in the weaving department and refused to open the doors.
Some of them were smoking cigarettes thereby causing
grave danger of setting the factory on fire.

The dyers congregated at the far end of the dyeing
department and started to shout insults at the Police
who were in attendance. A number of these dyers had
armed themselves with sticks and iron bars.
page_data.zh:
杂项 395/41。

1941年11月14日上午10时，约1,100名纺纱工决定复工，回到各自的机器旁。然而，上午10时30分，他们停止了机器运转，这可能是由于受到其他部门工人的压力所致。

1941年11月14日下午3时，社会运动指导委员会的三名代表，分别名为许云甫（Lee Yuen Tch）、王志武（Wong Ts Woo）和孔祥禧（Kung Chiang I），来到工厂，请求允许他们调解纠纷。然而，资方拒绝与他们交涉。警司Smith告知他们，他们的活动是非法的，并警告不得再犯。

经过进一步谈判，纺纱工和部分染色工决定启动机器，但煽动者从机器驱动轮上扯下多条皮带并关闭电机，阻止他们工作。

此时，织布工和部分染色工情绪激烈。织布工将自己锁在织布部内，拒绝开门。其中一些人在吸烟，从而造成引发工厂火灾的严重危险。

染色工聚集在染色部的远端，开始向在场的警察高声辱骂。其中一些染色工手持棍棒和铁条武装自己。

page_data.en:
Misc. 395/41.

At 4.55 p.m. on the 14-11-41 the Reserve Unit
was called out by Chief Inspector Trodd.
Squads of Police operating under the directions
of Supt. Chamberlain cleared the spinning and dyeing
departments without untoward incidents, but before
access could be gained to the weaving department
C.D.C. 95 had to climb through a window and unbolt
a door.
When the Police entered this department which
contained approximately 900 females, they were pelted
with shuttles and weft bobbins and it was found
necessary to use batons to subdue the mob.
Three workers sustained injuries, two of whom
received first aid treatment at the factory and the
other at St. Elizabeth's Hospital:-
(1) Yao Fong Ying (姚鳳英), 30 years, Anhwei,
F/Female, No. 1 Changping Le, Changping Road,
Minor injuries to head.
(2) Ts Kung oo (朱根華), 30 years, Anhwei,
M/Male, Unnumbered house on Markham Road,
Contusion of buttock.
(3) Tsang ..au Mei (張不妹), 24 years, Foochow,
F/Female, 87 Jung Ka Meng, Sinza Road,
Trauma of right leg. Detained in Hospital.
There were no Police casualties.
The factory was cleared and the mob dispersed
from the vicinity at 6.30 p.m. 14-11-41.
The factory will be closed until an amicable
settlement has been reached.
D.O. "B" and members of the Special Branch
attended.

D.D.C. "B" Div.

Copy to Cp. Br.

J. Smith
D.S.I.

HTT/..
page_data.zh:
杂项 395/41。

1941年11月14日下午4时55分，特罗德（Trodd）总督察召出后备队。
在张伯伦（Chamberlain）警司的指挥下，警察小队清除了纺纱部和染色部，未发生不幸事件，但在进入织布部之前，副巡捕95号不得不爬过窗户并打开门闩。
当警察进入这个约有900名女工的部门时，她们向警察投掷梭子和纬管，警方发现有必要使用警棍来制服人群。
三名工人受伤，其中两人在工厂接受了急救治疗，另一人在圣伊丽莎白医院接受治疗：-
(1) 姚凤英，30岁，安徽籍，女，昌平路昌平乐1号，头部轻伤。
(2) 朱根华（Ts Kung oo），30岁，安徽籍，男，马克姆路无门牌号房屋，臀部挫伤。
(3) 张不妹（Tsang ..au Mei），24岁，福州籍，女，新闸路荣嘉孟87号，右腿外伤。留院观察。
警方无伤亡。
工厂于1941年11月14日下午6时30分被清空，人群从附近散去。
工厂将关闭，直至达成和解。
“B”区警务处长及特别处成员到场。

“B”区副警务处长

抄送：中央捕房

J. Smith
副警司

page_data.en:
Workers' Demands.

(1) An increase of 50% in wages be enforced.
(2) That the "cheap" rice be obtained not in excess of $80.00
per picul and every worker be given $2.00 daily for rice
allowance.
(3) That a special H.C.L. allowance of $1.00 be grant.
(4) That ½ of a picul of cheap rice be supplied during each term.
(5) Wages and rice allowances be paid as usual on the occasion of
Sundays or holidays.
(6) That workers be not dismissed with cause.
(7) That workers be still allowed to live in the two living
quarters supplied by the Mill otherwise a daily house
rent should be paid to workers.

（印：INDEXED BY (S.B.) REGISTRY DATE 5/11/6）
page_data.zh:
工人要求。

(1) 强制执行工资增加50%。
(2) “平价”米每担价格不超过80.00元，并向每名工人每天发放2.00元作为米贴。
(3) 授予特别生活成本津贴1.00元。
(4) 每期供应半担平价米。
(5) 星期日或节假日照常支付工资和米贴。
(6) 不得无故解雇工人。
(7) 允许工人继续居住在工厂提供的两处宿舍内，否则应向工人支付每日房租。

Further to Strike of workers in the Hung Chang
Cotton Mill at No. 381 Markham Road.

At 9a.m. on 8/12/36, the letter (received by the
above mill from the Bureau of Social Affairs) as referred
to on Diary 25, was obtained from the management and a
copy taken, same reads as follows:-
Character Hai No. 6211. Dated 6/12/36.
Instructional Order to Hung Chang Cotton Mill.
It has come to the notice of this Bureau that
workers have been dismissed by your management for making
preparation to organise a Labour Union. This action of
your mill is against the "true meaning" of the labour
and capitalists co-operation and mediation. But on the
contrary the dismissed workers, without first reporting
their dismissal to this Bureau and ask for mediation,
agitated a number of workers and led them to the mill to
cause disturbance and "Tai Kung" (stoppage of work) was
also on the wrong procedure.
It has been decided by this Bureau that those
workers who played an active part in the disturbance,
viz,-Shu Yah Vung, Hoo Kung Zai, Yue Fai Ching, Yue Ah
Miau, Zau Ah Yung, Bei Tsung Yung, Lieu Zung Zai,(7 in
all) be allowed to be dismissed by your management, but
for the sake of mercy two months extra wages be given
to them as compensation, whilst the following four workers,
Zee Pau Ching, Wong Yue Sung, Wong Ah Zai, and Zee Sing Poo

关于马克姆路381号鸿章棉纺厂工人罢工的后续情况。

1936年12月8日上午9时，从上述工厂管理层处获取了日记第25条中提到的信件（由上述工厂从社会局收到），并复印了一份，内容如下：-
海字第6211号。日期1936年12月6日。
致鸿章棉纺厂指令。
本局获悉，贵厂管理层因工人准备组织工会而将其解雇。贵厂的这一行动违背了劳资合作与调解的“真意”。但是，另一方面，被解雇的工人未先向本局报告解雇情况并请求调解，而是煽动多名工人并带领他们到工厂制造骚乱，且“怠工”（停工）的程序也是错误的。
本局决定，允许贵厂管理层解雇那些在骚乱中起积极作用的工人，即：舒亚云（Shu Yah Vung）、胡根仔（Hoo Kung Zai）、余费清（Yue Fai Ching）、余阿妙（Yue Ah Miau）、赵阿荣（Zau Ah Yung）、卞春荣（Bei Tsung Yung）、刘顺才（Lieu Zung Zai）（共7人），但出于仁慈，应给予他们两个月的额外工资作为补偿，而以下四名工人，徐宝庆（Zee Pau Ching）、王友生（Wong Yue Sung）、王阿仔（Wong Ah Zai）和徐兴甫（Zee Sing Poo）

（印：特别处

revealed that the four ex-employees(as referred to in

-ment.

At 8a.m. on 7/12/36, information was received from
the above mill to the effect that certain men, (previously
dismissed as a result of a disturbance amongst the workers)
were present in the mill and demanded to be reinstated.

Enquiries by the undersigned and C.D.S. 202 ascer-
tained the following:-

At about 5p.m. on 5/12/36 a letter, addressed to the
Management of the above mill, was received from the Bureau
of Social Affairs, wherein it was suggested, or advised,
that out of the 11 previously dismissed employees, 4 should
be reinstated, the remainder to be paid the two months
salary owing them.

As a result of this, 2 of the workers, as under,
appeared at the mill a.m. 7/12/36, demanding to be rein-
stated, but when firmly told by the Management that such
a proposal would not be considered, for a moment, they left.

1936年12月7日下午3时许，上述前七名人员领清了所有欠款，安静离开，但第8和第9名人员拒绝接受其应付工资（以及他们的朋友，即上述第10和第11名），随后不久离开了厂区。预计他们将于明天1936年12月8日返回。

秘书施汉章（Ts Hai Tsung）先生告知本人，对于目前寻求在工厂重新雇佣的四名男子，将不予任何考虑，因为此前的事件及其附带事故被视为已结案：这四名男子尚未领取应付工资，现在正在“争吵”以期复职，但施先生表示，这是没有希望的，因为已明确决定无视社会局来信中概述的建议。

Crime Diary.

Register No.677/36.
"B" Division
Gordon Road Station
Nov. 2, 1936.

Offences Intimidation.

Place: 381 Markham Road, Hung Chang Cotton Mill.
Time: About 6 a.m. 2.11.36.
Time reported: 6.30 a.m. 2.11.36.
Name of complainant: Zung Yue Nan (郑有南) Works manager, above address.

Number of criminals : 6 in custody:
(1). Wong Ah Pao (王阿保), 18, Kompo, F/worker, residing 361 Mogi Road;
(2). Wong Ah Pao (王阿保), 18, Kompo, F/worker, residing straw hut Kwang Shao Road, Chapei.
(3). Zung Siau Doo (张少杜) 19 Zangchow, F/worker.
(4). Sung Ziang Sung (宋江松), 32, Kompo, residing 3951 Robison Road;
(5). Sung Ah Kung (宋阿公), 48, Ningpo, residing 32/400 Tonquin Road;
(6). Zee Ah Woo (徐阿五) 29, Kompo, residing 16 Hung Kong Li, Penang Road.

罪行 恐吓。

地点：马克姆路381号，恒昌纱厂。
时间：1936年11月2日上午6点左右。
报案时间：1936年11月2日上午6:30。
控告人姓名：郑有南（Zung Yue Nan），上述地址工厂经理。

罪犯人数：6人在押：
(1). 王阿保（Wong Ah Pao），18岁，广东籍，女工，居住莫吉路（Mogi Road）361号；
(2). 王阿保（Wong Ah Pao），18岁，广东籍，女工，居住闸北广肇路（Kwang Shao Road）草棚。
(3). 张少杜（Zung Siau Doo）19岁，漳州籍，女工。
(4). 宋江松（Sung Ziang Sung），32岁，广东籍，居住罗宾森路（Robison Road）3951号；
(5). 宋阿公（Sung Ah Kung），48岁，宁波籍，居住唐吉路（Tonquin Road）32/400号；
(6). 徐阿五（Zee Ah Woo）29岁，广东籍，居住槟榔路（Penang Road）16号兴康里。

实施逮捕。由侦探小队逮捕6人。

....
....
....

本案六名被告共同结伙，通过威胁手段恐吓并企图阻止恒昌纱厂工人进行正常的日常工作。

page_data.en:
Sheet No. 2

At 6.30 a.m. 2.11.36, a telephone message was received
at Gordon Road Station from the Hung Chang Cotton Mill, 381
Markham Road, reporting that workers were being intimidated
at the above mill.

Upon receipt of the above message the undersigned -
C.D.S. 153 and a Party of Uniformed Police attended and found
detained in the Office situated within the Mill compound 3
Chinese Female Workers, names as follows:-
(1) Wong Ah Pau, 18, F/Millworker, Kompo, residing 361 Moji Rd.
(2) Wong Ah Pau, 18 F/Millworker, Kompo, residing Kwang Zau
Road, Chapei.
(3) Zung Siau Doo, 19, F/Millworker, residing 13 Hang Tsung
Road, Chapei.

Who had been concerned together in intimidating and attempting
to prevent the day workers from carrying on with their work in
the above named Mill. This attempt did not materialize and
upon arrival of the Police all the day workers had commenced.
work.

Subsequent enquiries by D.S. White C.D.S. 153 and 187
revealed the followings:- at 7.20 p.m. 28.9.36, a strike of
workers employed by the Ung Chang Cotton Mill situated at 381
Markham Road commenced and this is now the subject of
(G.R. Misc. 14/36 Political).

About 5.50 a.m. 2.11.36, Sung Ching Tse, employed as
a day-shift foreman at the above mentioned Mill arrived at the
Mill for work and whilst in the Spinning Room which comes under
his ████ charge he received information to the effect that the
Night Workers were going to cause trouble when leaving at 6 a.m.
page_data.zh:
第2页

1936年11月2日上午6:30，戈登路巡捕房接到来自马克姆路381号恒昌纱厂的电话消息，报告该厂工人受到恐吓。

收到上述消息后，下述人员——
刑事侦探警长（C.D.S.）153号及一队制服警察前往现场，发现厂区内办公室内扣留了三名中国女工，姓名如下：-
(1) 王阿保（Wong Ah Pau），18岁，女/纱厂工人，广东籍，居住莫吉路（Moji Rd.）361号。
(2) 王阿保（Wong Ah Pau），18岁，女/纱厂工人，广东籍，居住闸北广肇路（Kwang Zau Road）。
(3) 张少杜（Zung Siau Doo），19岁，女/纱厂工人，居住闸北杭宗路（Hang Tsung Road）13号。

她们共同结伙，恐吓并企图阻止日班工人在上述纱厂继续工作。这一企图未能得逞，警察到达时，所有日班工人已开始工作。

随后，怀特（White）刑事侦探警长（C.D.S.）153号和187号进行的调查揭示了以下情况：- 1936年9月28日晚上7:20，位于马克姆路381号的恒昌纱厂工人开始罢工，此事现为（戈登路杂项 14/36 政治类）的主题。

1936年11月2日上午5:50左右，在上述纱厂担任日班领班的宋庆泽（Sung Ching Tse）到厂上班，在他负责的████纺纱车间内，他收到消息，称夜班工人将在上午6点下班离厂时制造麻烦。

page_data.en:
Sheet No. 3.

Sung Ching Tse passed this information
to Zung Yue Na Works Manager in the Mill Office,
situated within the Compound, and returned to the
work-room and upon entering about 6.5 a.m. he
witnessed Wong Ah Pau, the 1st named F/Millworker,
mentioned above intimidating Millworkers about
to commence work on the day shift by preventing
them from running their machines and threatening
them with Assault when they left the Factory later,
should they commence work that day.

Sung Ching Tse returned to the Office and
reported this disturbance to Zung Yue Nan, who then
with Sung Ching Tse, went immediately back to the
work-room where Wong Ah Pau was located.

Zung Yue Nan, then took her to the office
for questioning re the cause of her actions. At
this time, about 6.5 a.m. 50% of the machines
were running in charge of the day workers, other
day workers with those who had just finished Night
work being present in the work-rooms and adjoining
compound, the Day Workers having been prevented
from running their machines by the actions of
Wong Ah Pau and the 2nd and 3rd named.

After the removal of Wong Ah Pau from
the work-room by Zung Yue Nan, the clerk of the
department; Ling Vung Shu then witnessed the 2nd
named, Wong Ah Pau, attempting to prevent the
page_data.zh:
第3页。

宋庆泽将此信息传递给位于厂区内的厂办公室经理郑有南（Zung Yue Na），然后返回车间，大约在上午6:05进入车间时，他目睹上述第一名女工王阿保恐吓即将开始日班工作的纱厂工人，阻止他们开动机器，并威胁如果他们当天开工，离厂时将遭受殴打。

宋庆泽返回办公室，将此骚乱报告给郑有南（Zung Yue Nan），随后郑有南与宋庆泽立即返回车间，找到王阿保所在之处。

郑有南随即将其带到办公室，询问其行为原因。此时，大约上午6:05，50%的机器由日班工人操作运行，其他日班工人以及刚结束夜班工作的工人都在车间及相邻厂区内，由于王阿保及第二、第三名列名者的行动，日班工人被阻止开动机器。

郑有南将王阿保带离车间后，部门职员凌文叔（Ling Vung Shu）随即目睹第二名列名者王阿保试图阻止

page_data.en:
Sheet No. 4.

the Night workers from leaving the work-room
and agitating with the Day-workers not to commence
work under threats of Assault when they left the
factory Ling Vung Shu requested her not to interfer
or cause any distrubance amongst they day workers
and to leave the premises. To this request she paid
no attention and persisted in her efforts to bring
about an impasse with the night and day workers to
prevent work being continued. She was then also taken
to the Office by Ling Vung Shu and detained.
Zung Yue Nan, works manager then returned to
the work-room (now about 6.20 a.m.) when all the
night workers should have left, but many of whom were
still present in the room mingled with day workers who
had been frightened to commence work. Whilst trying
to ascertain the cause of the dis-satisfaction he
witnessed the 3rd named Zung Siau Doo, stop 7 machines
which were being operated by day workers at the same
time stating that if they did not stop work they would
be assaulted upon leaving the mill. Her removal by
Zung Yue Nan, finally settled the disturbance within
the work-room and the day workers resumed their work.
Whilst being removed from the work-room,
Zung Siau Doo, picked up a wooden spindle (Exhibit)
with which she attempted to assault Zung Yue
Nan, but was prevented causing any serious to
injury, and also removed to the office
page_data.zh:
第4页。

夜班工人离开车间，并煽动日班工人不要开始工作，威胁他们离厂时将遭受殴打。凌文叔要求她不要干涉或在日班工人中制造任何混乱，并离开厂区。她对这一请求置之不理，坚持努力造成夜班和日班工人之间的僵局，以阻止工作继续。随后她也被凌文叔带到办公室并予以扣留。
工厂经理郑有南随后返回车间（此时约上午6:20），此时所有夜班工人本应已离开，但许多人仍留在车间内，与因害怕而不敢开始工作的日班工人混在一起。在试图查明不满原因时，他目睹第三名列名者张少杜停止了7台由日班工人操作的机器，同时声称如果不停止工作，她们离厂时将遭受殴打。郑有南将其带离，最终平息了车间内的骚乱，日班工人恢复了工作。
在被带离车间时，
张少杜捡起一根木制锭子（证物），企图袭击郑有南，但未造成严重伤害，随后也被带往办公室

page_data.en:
- 5 -

The removal of the three agitators quelled any
further disturbance and all the Night Workers left the
premises without any further incidents and all the Day workers
commenced work.

The 3 above mentioned females brought to the station
and interrogated admitted having participated in the
abortive attempt to bring about another strike at the
Mill as outlined above. Further questioned they stated
that one named Sung Ziang Sung, employed in the Mill
as a Machine Oiler had instructed them in the parts they
had to play in the attempt to bring about another stoppage
and further unrest amongst the workers.

Sung Ziang Sung, 32, M/Millworker, residing 395l Robison
Road, was taken into custody from the Mill compound at 11.45
a.m. 2/11/36, and brought to the station and interrogated
admitted having with two other workers, Sung Ah Aung, and
Zee Ah Woo attended a meeting held at No.20 Dzoong Tuh
Lee, Hung Fung Road, Chapel, Offices of the Labour Union, 2
p.m. 1/11/36 where apparently it had been decided to deceive
the workers of the Hung Chang Cotton Mill into coming out on strike
again on the pretext that the management was going to reduce
their wages by 20%.

Sung Ah Kung was arrested at 12/15 a.m. 2/11/36 at
32/400 Tonquin Road and questioned at the station admitted
having attended the Labour Meeting as stated above and
having with the others taken part in the discussion and
agreement to cause dissatisfaction amongst the workers
as outlined above.

Zee Ah Woo, 29, M/Mill worker, employed by the Hung
Chang Cotton Mill was next taken into custody at 6.30 p.m.
page_data.zh:
- 5 -

三名煽动者被带离后，任何进一步的骚乱得以平息，所有夜班工人离开厂区，未发生其他事件，所有日班工人开始工作。

上述三名女性被带到巡捕房并接受讯问，承认参与了上述旨在引发纱厂另一次罢工的未遂企图。经进一步讯问，她们陈述称，一名名为宋江松（Sung Ziang Sung）的人，受雇于该厂担任加油工，指示了她们在企图引发另一次停工及工人进一步动荡中必须扮演的角色。

宋江松，32岁，男/纱厂工人，居住罗宾森路395l号，于1936年11月2日上午11:45在厂区内被拘留，并被带到巡捕房接受讯问，承认与另外两名工人宋阿公（Sung Ah Aung）和徐阿五（Zee Ah Woo）一起，参加了1936年11月1日下午2点在鸿福路（Hung Fung Road）钟德里（Dzoong Tuh Lee）20号礼拜堂劳工工会办事处举行的会议，会上显然决定以资方打算削减工资20%为借口，欺骗恒昌纱厂工人再次罢工。

宋阿公于1936年11月2日凌晨12:15在唐吉路32/400号被捕，并在巡捕房接受讯问时承认参加了上述劳工会议，并与其他人一起参与讨论并同意如上所述在工人中制造不满情绪。

徐阿五，29岁，男/纱厂工人，受雇于恒昌纱厂，随后于下午6:30被拘留。

page_data.en:
- 6 -

2/11/36, at the Mill premises and questioned at the
station admitted his part in the attempt to bring about
unrest amongst the workers and his attendance at the
labour meeting at 2 p.m. 1/11/36, with the other two
male Chinese mentioned above.

In this case it must be noted that acts of intimidation
have occurred frequently since the commencement of the
dispute at the Hung Chang Cotton Mill on the 28/9/36,
and on only one previous occasion has direct evidence
been available against any particular person/s (G.R. F.I.
R. 638/36).

Untiring efforts of the Management of the Mill and
the Bureau of Social Affairs since the 28/9/36, have
only recently shown results in bringing the original
unrest amongst the workers to a satisfactory conclusion.

The action of the above six named with the assistance
of the unofficial Labour Union (3rd Cotton Weaving
Preliminary Office, Chapei) composed chiefly of recently
dismissed employees, is an effort to bring about further
unrest amongst the workers by circulating rumours that the
management intended to reduce their pay 20% (ascertained from
the management to be without the slightest foundation of the
truth) and their concentrated action at the mill 6 a.m. 2/11/36
when they attempted to prevent the Day workers commencing work
by intimidation and threats of assault if not obeyed, the
result of a premeditated plan of action.

The 6 named therefore have been charged under Art. 304
Section 1 of the C.C.C. and will appear before the S.S.D.
Court a.m. 3/11/36. All concerned have been warned to attend.

Statements have been taken from each and are attached.
page_data.zh:
- 6 -

1936年11月2日，在厂区内，并在巡捕房接受讯问时承认其在企图在工人中制造动荡中的作用，以及其与上述另外两名中国男性一起参加1936年11月1日下午2点的劳工会议的情况。

在此案中必须指出，自1936年9月28日恒昌纱厂纠纷开始以来，恐吓行为频繁发生，且仅在之前一次场合中有针对特定个人的直接证据（戈登路 F.I. R. 638/36）。

自1936年9月28日以来，纱厂资方和社会局不懈努力，最近才使工人最初的动荡局面得到令人满意的解决。

上述六名列名者在非官方工会（闸北第三棉织预备办事处，主要由近期被解雇的员工组成）的协助下采取行动，是通过散布资方打算削减工资20%的谣言（经向资方查证，此说法毫无事实依据）来引发工人进一步动荡的努力，而他们于1936年11月2日上午6点在纱厂的集中行动，即试图通过恐吓和威胁如不服从将遭受殴打来阻止日班工人开工，是预谋行动计划的结果。

因此，这六名列名者已根据《中华民国刑法》第304条第1款被起诉，并将于1936年11月3日上午出庭受审。所有相关人员均已警告到庭。

已获取每人的供词并附后。

page_data.en:
Statement of Sung Ah Aung (宋阿松), native of Ningpo.
G. Rd. Stn. on the 2/11/36

My name is Sung Ah Aung, age 48 years, native of Ningpo,
residing 420 Lonquin Road. I have been employed as an oiler
at the Hung Chang Cotton Mill since March of the 11th Year
of Chinese Republic (1922). At about 12 noon on the 31/10/36,
when I was "shopping" on Changping Road I met one mill worker
whom I know as Tsai June Ziang. He called me to go to No.20
Dzoong Luh Lee, Hung Feng Road, Chapei, where the labour union
is situated. I accompanied him to the said place and waited
there until 2 p.m. the same day. A meeting was then held and
at which it was decided that in case the mill manager wanted
to deduct our wages from the 1/11/36 (Monday), the day workers
who enter the mill should not commence work and the night workers
who worked previous night should not leave the mill in order to
make it as a demand. At 11.30 p.m. on 1/11/36 when I was
mentioning this decision of the meeting to Sung Ziang Sung and
Zee Ah Woo in the "Fine Cotton" Room of the Hung Chang Mill,
it was overheard by some of the female workers. I did not
expect that the disturbance will start this morning amongst
the female workers.

Signed: Sung Ah Kung.
page_data.zh:
宋阿松（Sung Ah Aung）供词，宁波籍。
戈登路捕房，1936年11月2日

本人宋阿松，48岁，宁波籍，住隆庆路420号。自民国11年（1922年）3月起，受雇于鸿章纱厂担任加油工。1936年10月31日中午12时许，本人在昌平路“购物”时，遇见一名认识的工厂工人蔡俊祥（Tsai June Ziang，音译）。他叫我去闸北虹丰路崇德里20号，即工会所在地。本人随他前往该处，并一直等到当天下午2时。随后召开会议，会上决定：如果厂方打算从1936年11月1日（星期一）起扣除我们的工资，那么当天进厂的日班工人不应开始工作，前一夜工作的夜班工人不应离开工厂，以此作为要求。1936年11月1日晚上11时30分，当本人在鸿章纱厂“细纱间”向孙祥生（Sung Ziang Sung）和徐阿五（Zee Ah Woo）提及会议的这一决定时，被一些女工听到。本人未曾预料到今早女工中会发生骚乱。

签名：宋阿根（Sung Ah Kung）。

page_data.en:
Statement of Sung Ziang Sung (孙祥生), native of Kompo.
G.R. Stn. on the 2/11/36

My name is Sung Ziang Sung, age 32 years, native of
Kompo, residing 3951 Dah Shoo Lee, Robison Road. I have been
employed as an oiler at the Tung Chang Cotton Mill since
October 1931. At about 2 p.m. on the 1/11/36 one of my co-
workers whose name I do not know came to my home and called me to go
to No.20 Dzoong Luh Lee, Hung Feng Road, Chapei, the premises
occupied by Labour Union. On my arrival it was already about
3p.m. The meeting was over and all attendance left, therefore
I did not hear any decision in the meeting. I returned home.
I went to the mill at 5.30 p.m. for night shift. I worked until
11.30 p.m. the mid-night meal time was due and I left the working
room and on my way to dining room I passed winding room and I
heard Sung Ah Kung talk to Lee Ah Woo. I went up to them and
asked them about the decision of the meeting in the Labour Union.
They then all told me that the meeting decision being that if
the mill management wanted to cut 20 per cent wages from workers
all should oppose and all day duty shift should not start work
and night duty members should not leave the mill waiting for
the management's promise not to cut their wages. I do not know
about the origin of the disturbance this morning. This is my
true statement.

Signed:Zung Ziang Sung.
page_data.zh:
孙祥生（Sung Ziang Sung）供词，高邮（Kompo，音译）籍。
戈登路捕房，1936年11月2日

本人孙祥生，32岁，高邮（Kompo，音译）籍，住罗宾森路大树里3951号。自1931年10月起，受雇于同昌纱厂担任加油工。1936年11月1日下午2时许，我的一名同事（姓名不详）来到我家，叫我去闸北虹丰路崇德里20号，即工会占用之处。当我到达时，已约下午3时。会议已结束，所有与会者均已离开，因此我未听到会议的任何决定。我便回家了。下午5时30分，我去工厂上夜班。工作至晚上11时30分，正值夜餐时间，我离开工作间，在去餐厅的路上经过摇纱间，听见宋阿根（Sung Ah Kung）与李阿五（Lee Ah Woo）谈话。我走上前去，向他们询问工会会议的决定。他们随即告诉我，会议决定是：如果厂方要削减工人20%的工资，所有人都应反对，所有日班人员不应开始工作，夜班人员不应离开工厂，等待厂方承诺不削减工资。我不清楚今早骚乱的起因。这是我的真实供词。

签名：孙祥生（Zung Ziang Sung）。

page_data.en:
Statment of Zung Siao Doo (□ □ □), native of Zangchow.
G.R. Station on the 2/11/36.

my name is Zung Siao Doo, age 19, native of Zangchow,
residing at no.47 Hong Yung Faung off Hai Chung Road, Chapei.
About 2 p.m. on the 1/11/36 when I was sleeping at
my own home, one fellow female worker, as I called her
adopted mother, came to my home and told me that I should
not go outside when finished the night work. Be careful
of being assaulted by others, that I should come out of
the mill together with the male and female workers.
Further she told me that I had better not turn on night
shift tonight.
Until 6 a.m. this morning (2/11/36) I just got ready
to leave off my work, and heard many female workers, shouting
"Off duty workers don't go outside" and "Day shift workers
don't turn on work". "If you people don't take this advice,
you would be assaulted by them." Just when I was standing
in the Spinning room, I was pushed by some others from
behind which action was seen by the mill staff, I was
therefore brought to the station. This is my true statement.

Signed, Zung Siao Doo.
page_data.zh:
钟小杜（Zung Siao Doo，□ □ □）供词，常州（Zangchow，音译）籍。
戈登路捕房，1936年11月2日。

本人钟小杜（Zung Siao Doo），19岁，常州（Zangchow，音译）籍，住闸北海忠路旁宏永坊47号。1936年11月1日下午2时许，当我正在家中睡觉时，一位我称为“干妈”的女工友来到我家，告诉我下夜班后不要外出。要小心被他人殴打，我应该与男女工友一起离开工厂。此外，她还告诉我，今晚最好不上夜班。
直到今天早上（1936年11月2日）6点，我刚准备下班，听到许多女工高喊“下班工人不要出去”和“日班工人不要开工”。“如果你们不听劝告，就会被她们殴打。”正当我站在纺纱间时，被身后的人推搡，这一行为被厂方职员看到，因此我被带到捕房。这是我的真实供词。

签名：钟小杜（Zung Siao Doo）。

page_data.en:
Statement of(2) Wong Ah Pao, native of nompo.
G.K. on the 2/11/36.

My name is Wong Ah Pao, age 18, native of nompo,
residing unnumbered straw hut in Yung Kang Li off Kwang Shao
Road, Chapei, and employed by the Hung Chang Cotton mill
as a night worker.
About 12 mid-night 1-2/11/36, when I was just working
in the spinning room, I was approached by three male workers,
one named Sung Ah Kung (宋阿根), and one named Sung Ziang
Sung (□□□) and the 3rd one unknown to me, they three were
engaged in oiling, and they three told me that I should not
go out when finished the night work at 6 a.m. the next morning,
stating that "If you female workers go outside, you would
be assaulted by them." "You had better go out together with
male workers." Indeed, it was actually Sung Ah Kung and Sung
Ziang Sung, who prevented us to go outside, This is my
true statement.

Cross signed, Wong Ah Pao.
page_data.zh:
黄阿宝（Wong Ah Pao）供词(2)，宁波（nompo，音译）籍。
戈登路捕房，1936年11月2日。

本人黄阿宝，18岁，宁波（nompo，音译）籍，住闸北光绍路永康里无号草棚，受雇于鸿章纱厂担任夜班工人。
1936年11月1日至2日午夜12时许，当我正在纺纱间工作时，三名男工走近我，其中一人名叫宋阿根（Sung Ah Kung），一人名叫孙祥生（Sung Ziang Sung，□□□），第三人我不认识。他们三人都是做加油工作的，他们三人告诉我，第二天早上6点下夜班后不要出去，声称“如果你们女工出去，就会被他们殴打”。“你们最好和男工一起出去。”实际上，确实是宋阿根和孙祥生阻止我们出去。这是我的真实供词。

交叉签名：黄阿宝（Wong Ah Pao）。

page_data.en:
Statment of(1st)Wong Ah rao ( 黄亚 Rao ), native of Kompo.
G.R. on the 2/11/36.

My name is Wong Ah rao, age 18, native of Kompo,
residing at No.361 Moji Road. I am employed as a spinner
by the Hung Chang Cotton Mill, No.518.
At about 5 p.m. on 1/11/36 I went to the Mill for
turning up the night shift. The next morning 2/11/36
at 5.30 a.m. the night work finished, but I did not come
out. Owing to the fact that when I was working in the
work-room about 12 mid-night, I was approached by two male
workers, whose names were unknown to me, but they both were
engaged in oiling. They both told me that I should not go
out the next morning when finished night work, because there
were some persons intending to assault me, I therefore waited
until 6 a.m. When passing through the spinning room I saw
that some disturbance was taking place, but at the same time,
some of the mill staff were on the scene, they then suspected
me having created disturbance, I was brought to the mill
office first and then I was brought to the station. This is
my true statement.

Cross signed, Wong Ah rao.
page_data.zh:
黄亚饶（Wong Ah rao，黄亚 Rao）供词(1)，高邮（Kompo，音译）籍。
戈登路捕房，1936年11月2日。

本人黄亚饶（Wong Ah rao），18岁，高邮（Kompo，音译）籍，住莫吉路361号。受雇于鸿章纱厂518号机位担任挡车工。
1936年11月1日下午5时许，我去工厂上夜班。第二天早上1936年11月2日5时30分，夜班结束，但我没有出来。原因是午夜12时许，当我在工作间工作时，两名男工走近我，他们的名字我不知道，但他们都是做加油工作的。他们两人都告诉我，第二天早上夜班结束后不要出去，因为有人意图殴打我，因此我一直等到早上6点。经过纺纱间时，我看到发生了一些骚乱，但与此同时，一些厂方职员也在现场，他们随即怀疑是我制造了骚乱，我先被带到厂办公室，然后被带到捕房。这是我的真实供词。

交叉签名：黄亚饶（Wong Ah rao）。

page_data.en:
Statement of Zee Ah Woo (徐阿五), native of Kompo.
G.R. on the 2/11/36.

My name is Zee Ah Woo, age 29, native of Kompo,
residing No.12 Hung Chong Li off Penang Road, and employed
by the Sung Chang Cotton Mill as a workman since 1930.
About 2 p.m. on the 1/10/36 I was taking food in a
food-shop situated at the corner of Gordon and Robison
Roads where I was approached by one named Koo Shing Tsai,
(顧新榮) who told me to go to the Labour Union at 20
Tsoong Tuh Li off Hung Fong Road, Chapei, and informed one
named Chun Yue Ding (陳月定) to declare that I should
assist the female workers on strike on the 2nd day.
At that time Sung Ziang Sung was in the Union office, who
stated that he would prevent all these female workers in
his room to go out. On the same night about 1 a.m. Sung
Ziang Sung came to my machine room and told me that I
should stop these female workers from working and not allowed
them to go out. I replied that let each female stop work
at liberty, because I could not prevent them by myself
alone. The next morning at 6 a.m. I saw the mill light
flashing red, when Sung Ziang Sung was seen standing on
the Main gate and prevented the female workers to go out.
This is my true statement.

Signed. Zee Ah Woo.
page_data.zh:
徐阿五（Zee Ah Woo）供词，高邮（Kompo，音译）籍。
戈登路捕房，1936年11月2日。

本人徐阿五，29岁，高邮（Kompo，音译）籍，住槟榔路洪钟里12号，自1930年起受雇于松昌纱厂（Sung Chang Cotton Mill）担任工人。
1936年10月1日下午2时许，我正在戈登路与罗宾森路转角处的一家饭馆吃饭，一个叫顾新荣（Koo Shing Tsai）的人走近我，叫我去闸北虹丰路崇德里20号的工会，并通知一个叫陈月定（Chun Yue Ding）的人，声明我应在第二天协助女工罢工。
当时孙祥生（Sung Ziang Sung）在工会办公室，他说他将阻止他房间里的所有女工出去。当晚凌晨1时许，孙祥生来到我的机器间，告诉我应该阻止这些女工工作，并不允许她们出去。我回答说，让每个女工自由决定是否停工，因为我一个人无法阻止她们。第二天早上6点，我看到工厂灯光闪烁红光，看见孙祥生站在大门处，阻止女工出去。这是我的真实供词。

签名：徐阿五（Zee Ah Woo）。

S.B. REGISTER.
No. D 7543.
Date 3 / 11 / 36
Afternoon Translation.

November 3, 1936.

Lih Pao and other local newspapers:

WORKERS OF HOONG TSAUNG WEAVING AND DYEING FACTORY ON STRIKE

The Hoong Tsaung (鸿章) Weaving and Dyeing Factory, No.381 Markham Road, employs more than 1,000 workers. The other day, the management dismissed Ho Ken Zai (何根才) and several other workers for suggesting the formation of a labour union. This dismissal gave rise to much dissatisfaction among the workers who went on a "go-slow" strike, but on the advice of the Bureau of Social Affairs, the strikers returned to work.
Up to yesterday the management had not given any reply to the demands submitted by the workers nor had it reinstated the dismissed hands; on the contrary, it is reducing the workers' wages.
Yesterday morning the entire body of workers opened negotiations with the management, but without any result. The workers then went on strike and appointed representatives to make appeals to the local Tangpu and other government organs for assistance. These organs will detail officials to the factory this morning to mediate.

The Great Crystal (大晶報) publishes the following comment :-

JAPAN'S FOOLISH POLICY

Our enemy believes that after she has conquered this country, she would be free of China's vengeance. In the first place, will she be able to succeed in such a conquest and will such a conquest bring about the desired effect about which our enemy has been dreaming all the time? We say that she shall never succeed. Poland remained a Vassal State of Russia for nearly a century and has finally recovered her independence. Japan should realize that the spirit of nationalism among the Chinese people of to-day is very strong. Our enemy prefers to undertake the conquest of China, thereby creating general ill-feeling against her, rather than to co-operate with China for mutual prosperity and glory. What a foolish policy our enemy is now pursuing!
Let us remind our enemy not to be so proud and arrogant. She must realize that the 400,000,000 people of China are now ready for war and are prepared to fight a desperate struggle against her for the preservation of their existence as a nation. They are determined to smash the enemy forces.

鸿章纺织印染厂工人罢工

马克姆路381号鸿章纺织印染厂雇佣工人1000余名。日前，厂方因何根才（Ho Ken Zai）及其他几名工人建议组建工会而将其解雇。此次解雇引起工人极大不满，工人遂进行“怠工”罢工，但在社会局的劝告下，罢工工人返回工作岗位。
截至昨日，厂方既未对工人提出的要求给予任何答复，也未复职被解雇的员工；相反，厂方正在降低工人工资。
昨天上午，全体工人与厂方进行谈判，但无任何结果。工人随后罢工，并指派代表向当地塘浦及其他政府机关呼吁援助。这些机关将于今天上午派遣官员到工厂进行调解。

日本的愚蠢政策

我们的敌人认为，在征服这个国家后，她将免受中国的报复。首先，她能否成功实现这种征服？这种征服能否带来敌人一直梦寐以求的预期效果？我们要说，她绝不会成功。波兰作为俄罗斯的附庸国近一个世纪，最终恢复了独立。日本应该意识到，当今中国人民的民族主义精神非常强烈。我们的敌人宁愿采取征服中国的行动，从而引发对她的普遍反感，也不愿与中国合作以实现共同的繁荣和荣耀。我们的敌人现在推行的是多么愚蠢的政策啊！
让我们提醒我们的敌人不要如此骄傲和傲慢。她必须认识到，中国四亿人民现已准备好战争，并准备为保全其民族生存而与她进行殊死搏斗。他们决心粉碎敌军力量。

November 4, 1936.    Afternoon translation.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:
STRIKE AT THE HOONG TSAUNG COTTON MILL
The management of the Hoong Tsoung (鴻章)
Cotton Mill, No.381 Markham Road, has not only failed to
reinstate Ho Kan Zai (何根才) and several other dismissed
hands the other day, but has also reduced the wages of the
workers who had participated in the recent strike.
At 6 a.m. yesterday when the non-strikers
went to the factory to work, Sun Zieng Sun (孫祥生) and
other male workers instigated Wong Ah Pao (王阿宝) and
several other female workers to use the bobbins to strike
any worker who resumed work. The women mistook the
hands of the Wing On Cotton Mill in the vicinity for their
fellow workers and stood in their way. A clash ensued.
Upon learning of this, the Wing On Cotton Mill
immediately sent a telephone message to the Police whereupon
detectives and uniformed men arrived and took Wong Ah
Pao and 5 others into custody. The arrested persons
were brought before the Shanghai First Special District
Court yesterday morning when three of them were sentenced
to 5 days' detention each while the remaining three were
given 15 days' detention each.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:
WORKERS OF PAO HWA AND FIVE OTHER SILK WEAVING
FACTORIES ON STRIKE AGAIN
(宝華) At 7 a.m. yesterday the workers of the Pao Hwa
Road and five other silk weaving factories on Brenan
demanded the payment of their wages. As the demand
was ignored, the workers went on strike at 10 a.m.
The local Tangpu and other government organs
immediately instructed the strikers to wait calmly for
a settlement of the dispute. They will convene
representatives of both sides to a mediation meeting on
November 5.

Crystal (晶报) publishes the following articles:
THE
THE MAIN POINTS IN SINO-JAPANESE NEGOTIATIONS
Despite the several interviews between General
Chang Chun, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the National
Government, and Mr. Kawagoe, Japanese Ambassador to China,
no fresh developments in the Sino-Japanese negotiations
have taken place. This is due to the fact that Japan
is suggesting a united front against communists and the
demarkation of several provinces in North China into a
buffer district. These proposals cannot be accepted
by China.
Japan is now willing to make concessions and
is suggesting that autonomy be introduced in Hopei and
Charhar instead of in the five provinces in North China,
but she still insists on a united front against communists.

马克姆路381号鸿章（鴻章）纱厂管理层不仅日前未恢复何根才（Ho Kan Zai）及其他几名被解雇工人的职务，还降低了参与近期罢工的工人的工资。
昨天上午6点，当非罢工工人去工厂上班时，孙祥生（Sun Zieng Sun，音译）和其他男工煽动王阿宝（Wong Ah Pao）和其他几名女工用纱管殴打任何复工的工人。这些妇女误将附近的永安纱厂工人当作自己的同事并阻挡他们的去路。随后发生了冲突。
永安纱厂得知此事后，立即打电话给警方，随即侦探和制服警员赶到，将王阿宝及其他5人拘留。被捕人员昨天上午被提审至上海第一特区地方法院，其中三人被判处每人拘留5天，其余三人被判处每人拘留15天。

中日谈判要点
尽管国民政府外交部长张群将军（General Chang Chun）与日本驻华大使川越茂（Mr. Kawagoe）进行了多次会晤，但中日谈判没有新的进展。这是由于日本建议建立反共统一战线，并将华北数省划为非军事缓冲区。这些提议中国无法接受。
日本现在愿意做出让步，建议在河北和察哈尔实行自治，而不是在华北五省，但她仍坚持建立反共统一战线。

Hung Tsang Cotton Mill - agitation for the reinstatement of dismissed workers

In order to enforce a demand for the reinstatement of eleven workers recently dismissed by the management, three workers of the Hung Tsang Cotton Mill, 381 Markham Road, switched off the power in the Weaving Department at 6 a.m. November 2.

Six persons believed to be agitators among the workers of the mill were arrested by the Municipal Police and will be brought before the First Special District Court on Nov.3.

The situation in the mill is normal this morning.

Miscellaneous

Sandalwood and Dried Longan Shop Owners' Association - meeting

A general meeting of members of the Sandalwood and Dried Longan Shop Owners' Association was held at 5 p.m. November 2 in the office of the Association in Room 465, 66 Hankow Road, when the following resolutions were passed :-

1) That all members be warned against publishing advertisements in the newspapers or distributing handbills advertising their products with effect from Nov. 3, 1936, and that offenders against this resolution be fined $200.

2) That all members be warned against offering gifts for purchases made with effect from November 9, 1936, and offenders against this resolution be fined $50.

3) That all members be instructed not to hoist banners advertising sales after November 9, and that offenders against this resolution be fined $100.

The National Goods Exhibition, sponsored by the Chinese Chamber of Commerce at No.126 Bubbling Well Road, which opened on October 1, 1936, closed on November 1.

November 3, 1936. / Afternoon Translation. 3 // 36

Lih P'o and other local newspapers:

WORKERS OF HOONG TSAUNG WEAVING AND DYEING FACTORY ON STRIKE

The Hoong Tsaung (鸿章) Weaving and Dyeing Factory, No.381 Markham Road, employs more than 1,000 workers. The other day, the management dismissed Ho Kan Zai (何根才) and several other workers for suggesting the formation of a labour union. This dismissal gave rise to much dissatisfaction among the workers who went on a "go-slow" strike, but on the advice of the Bureau of Social Affairs, the strikers returned to work.
Up to yesterday the management had not given any reply to the demands submitted by the workers nor had it reinstated the dismissed hands; on the contrary, it is reducing the workers' wages.
Yesterday morning the entire body of workers opened negotiations with the management, but without any result. The workers then went on strike and appointed representatives to make appeals to the local Tangpu and other government organs for assistance. These organs will detail officials to the factory this morning to mediate.

The Great Crystal (大晶報) publishes the following comment :-

JAPAN'S FOOLISH POLICY

Our enemy believes that after she has conquered this country, she would be free of China's vengeance. In the first place, will she be able to succeed in such a conquest and will such a conquest bring about the desired effect about which our enemy has been dreaming all the time? We say that she shall never succeed. Poland remained a Vassal State of Russia for nearly a century and has finally recovered her independence. Japan should realize that the spirit of nationalism among the Chinese people of to-day is very strong. Our enemy prefers to undertake the conquest of China, thereby creating general ill-feeling against her, rather than to co-operate with China for mutual prosperity and glory. What a foolish policy our enemy is now pursuing!
Let us remind our enemy not to be so proud and arrogant. She must realize that the 400,000,000 people of China are now ready for war and are prepared to fight a desperate struggle against her for the preservation of their existence as a nation. They are determined to smash the enemy forces.

《立报》及其他本地报纸：

鸿章纺织印染厂工人罢工

位于马克姆路381号的鸿章（Hoong Tsaung）纺织印染厂雇有工人一千余名。日前，资方因何根才（Ho Kan Zai）及其他几名工人建议组建工会而将其解雇。此举引起工人的极大不满，他们进行了“怠工”罢工，但在社会局的劝告下，罢工者已复工。
截至昨日，资方既未对工人提出的要求给予任何答复，也未复职被解雇的工人；相反，资方正在降低工人工资。
昨日上午，全体工人与资方展开谈判，但毫无结果。随后工人举行罢工，并指派代表向当地塘浦及其他政府机关求助。这些机关将于今晨派遣官员前往工厂进行调解。

《大晶报》发表如下评论：——

日本的愚蠢政策

我们的敌人认为，在征服这个国家之后，她将免受中国的报复。首先，她能否成功实现这种征服？这种征服能否带来敌人一直梦寐以求的预期效果？我们要说，她绝不会成功。波兰作为俄罗斯的附庸国近一个世纪，最终恢复了独立。日本应当认识到，当今中国人民的民族主义精神非常强烈。我们的敌人宁愿采取征服中国的做法，从而招致普遍的敌意，也不愿与中国合作以实现共同的繁荣与荣耀。我们的敌人现在推行的政策是多么愚蠢啊！
让我们提醒我们的敌人不要如此骄傲自大。她必须认识到，中国四亿人民现已准备战争，并准备为保全其民族生存而与她进行殊死搏斗。他们决心粉碎敌军力量。

Unrest at present exists among 16 reserve shift
chauffeurs of the Nanfang Garage, 739 Avenue Edward VII

Chinese Journalists' Association and the abolition
of the S.M.C. Press Information Office

At a meeting held in their office, Room 630,
Continental Emporium Building, Nanking Road, between 5.30
p.m. and 6.30 p.m. October 19, seven committee members of
the Chinese Journalists' Association decided to form a
special committee with the co-operation of the Chinese
Daily Newspaper Proprietors' Association to study the
S.M.C.'s decision to abolish the Press Information Office.

Labour

Hung Tsang Cotton Mill - situation

In connection with the dispute between the workers
and the ex-workers of the Hung Tsang Cotton Mill, 381
Markham Road, which arose when the management dismissed
two employees for organizing a labour union (Vide I.R.
210/36), the Bureau of Social Affairs convened a meeting
in the Bureau on October 19 when representatives from both
parties were present. No satisfactory result was reached,
owing to the management persisting in its decision to pay off
the dismissed workers. A further meeting will be conducted
by the Bureau on October 21.

The dismissed employees and a number of strikers
prevented workers from reporting for duty this morning,
October 20, with the result that 406 of the day shift
hands are absent.

some of the workers were still absenting themselves

Special Committee to Raise Funds for the Purchase of Aircraft
to be presented to General Chiang Kai-shek - meeting

Fourteen members of the Special Committee to Raise Funds
for the Purchase of Aircraft to be Presented to General
Chiang Kai-shek held a meeting in the Chinese Y.M.C.A., 123
Boulevard de Montigny, between 5 p.m. and 6.10 p.m. October 12.
During the meeting, it was decided to postpone the ceremony
of naming the ten aeroplanes purchased from 2 p.m. October
15 to 2 p.m. October 25. The ceremony will be held at the
Lunghwa Aerodrome.

It was also resolved that a propaganda campaign be
conducted on October 25 by screening advertisements in local
cinemas bearing on the movement, and publishing special
articles in the press.

Labour

Hung Tsang Cotton Mill - situation

In connection with the dispute between the workers and
the management of the Hung Tsang Cotton Mill, 381 Markham
Road, which arose when the management dismissed two workers
for organizing a labour union (Vide I.R.2/10/36), 156 of the
850 night shift workers failed to report for duty on the
night of October 12/13, and 160 of the day shift workers
absented themselves this morning, October 13.

At 10 a.m. October 12, eight strikers, whom the management
had decided to dismiss (Vide I.R.9/10/36) called at the mill
when the foreman informed them of the decision of the manage-
ment and offered them their wages. The strikers refused to
accept the wages and left the mill half an hour later.

为购买飞机献给蒋介石将军筹款特别委员会 - 会议

为购买飞机献给蒋介石将军筹款特别委员会的十四名成员，于10月12日下午5时至6时10分，在蒙梯尼路（Boulevard de Montigny）123号中华基督教青年会举行会议。会议期间，决定将原定于10月15日下午2时举行的十架已购飞机命名仪式，推迟至10月25日下午2时举行。仪式将在龙华机场举行。

会议还决议，于10月25日开展宣传活动，在当地电影院放映与该运动相关的广告，并在报刊上发表专题文章。

劳工

鸿章棉纺厂 - 情况

关于鸿章棉纺厂（马克姆路381号）工人与管理层之间的纠纷，该纠纷起因于管理层因两名工人组织工会而将其解雇（参见 I.R.2/10/36），在10月12/13日夜班中，850名夜班工人中有156人未报到上班；而在10月13日今晨，日班工人中有160人缺勤。

10月12日上午10时，八名被管理层决定解雇的罢工者（参见 I.R.9/10/36）来到工厂，工头向他们通报了管理层的决定并支付其工资。罢工者拒绝接受工资，半小时后离开工厂。

Strike of workers in the Hung Chang Cotton Mill
at 381 Markham Road.

At 10a.m. 12/10/36, the eight workers(previously
referred to) attended at the mill and the works foreman
explained to them that the management had definitely
decided to dismiss them and offered them their pay which
had previously been prepared. This they would not accept.
The undersigned and D.S.I. Chu Meng Wei were present and
after the works foreman had finished they were warned
against intimidation and for creating any disturbance
being advised to take any grievance they may have to the
Bureau of Social Affairs. At 10.30a.m. all eight quietly
left the mill.

About 60 females (striking workers) had assembled
outside the mill during the above times.

The eight workers had been advised not to converse
with the crowd on leaving the mill. They did not do so,
the crowd remained quiet and all quietly left after seeing
the eight men walk away.

Between 5 & 6 p.m. 12/10/36 (change of shifts)
extra precautions were taken as the possibility of
trouble existed in view of the above action taken.
No incidents however occurred.

S.I

马克姆路381号鸿章棉纺厂工人罢工。

1936年10月12日上午10时，上述八名工人来到工厂，工头向他们解释管理层已坚决决定解雇他们，并提供了预先准备好的工资。他们拒绝接受。署名者及副督察朱孟伟（Chu Meng Wei）在场，在工头说完后，警告他们不得进行恐吓或制造任何骚乱，并建议如有不满应向上海市社会局提出。上午10时30分，八人均安静地离开工厂。

在上述时间段内，约有60名女工（罢工工人）聚集在工厂外。

已建议这八名工人在离开工厂时不要与人群交谈。他们照做了，人群保持安静，在看到八人走开后也都安静地离去。

1936年10月12日下午5时至6时（换班时间），鉴于上述采取的行动，存在发生麻烦的可能性，因此采取了额外的预防措施。然而，并未发生任何事件。

Labour
Hung Tsang Cotton Mill - situation

In connection with the dispute between the workers and
the management of the Hung Tsang Cotton Mill, 381 Markham
Road, which arose when the management dismissed two workers
for organizing a labour union (Vide I.R.2/10/36), 227 of the
850 night shift workers failed to report for duty on the
night of October 11/12, and 212 of the day shift absented
themselves this morning, October 12.

The strikers have been instructed by the Bureau of Social
Affairs to resume work pending a settlement of the dispute by
the authorities. Consequently some 60 strikers attempted to
resume work on the morning of Oct.9. They were, however,
prevented from doing so by the management.

At 5 p.m. the same day, some seventy strikers gained
admission to the mill during the changing over of shifts and
switched off the motor in the Weaving Department. They later
withdrew on the advice of the Municipal Police, who were
called to the scene by the management. Work was resumed at 6p.m.

Tseng Yuan Silk Factory - increases working period
Brenan Road,
The Tseng Yuan Silk Factory, 19 Teh Loong Fang, O.J.L.
which reduced its working period to six days per week on
October 6, 1936 (Vide I.R. 7/10/36), resumed its normal
working period on October 11, of six days and six nights a
week. This factory employs 52 hands.

关于鸿章棉纺厂（马克姆路381号）工人与管理层之间的纠纷，该纠纷起因于管理层因两名工人组织工会而将其解雇（参见 I.R.2/10/36），在10月11/12日夜班中，850名夜班工人中有227人未报到上班；而在10月12日今晨，日班工人中有212人缺勤。

社会局已指示罢工者在当局解决纠纷之前恢复工作。因此，约60名罢工者试图在10月9日上午恢复工作。然而，管理层阻止了他们这样做。

同日下午5时，约七十名罢工者在换班期间进入工厂，并关闭了织布部的马达。随后，他们在应管理层要求赶到现场的公共租界巡捕的建议下撤离。下午6时恢复工作。

曾源丝厂 - 增加工作时间
布伦南路（Brenan Road），
位于欧阳路（O.J.L.）德隆坊19号的曾源丝厂，曾于1936年10月6日将工作时间减少为每周六天（参见 I.R. 7/10/36），于10月11日恢复正常的每周六天六夜的工作时间。该厂雇用52名工人。

Strike of workers in the Hung Chang Cotton Mill
at 381 Markham Road.

At 11a.m. 10/10/36 Mr. W.C.Seeds and representatives
of the management came to the station as previously
arranged but only two of the nine workers awaiting
dismissal attended. They being
1,- Yue Hai Ching (余海清 )
2,- Yuen Ah Miau (袁阿妙 )
They stated they had not come as representatives
for the others but happened to be the only two attending.
It was obvious however they had attended prepared to
represent the others.
It was explained to these two that nothing could
be done through the medium of representatives and that
all must attend at the same time.
They then left the station after they had stated
they would arrange for them all to come to Gordon Road
at 11a.m. 11/10/36.
Bei Tsung Yung (卞寿荣 ) as shown on diary 9
page 1 is in the custody of Chapel Police and therefore
only 8 of the nine will be able to attend.
At 11.05a.m. 10/10/36, Tsang Lai Tsung (張蘭增 )
age 19, female, residing 935 Ferry Road and Woo Wei Ying
(胡惠英 ) age 38, female, 56 Tah Tuh Li Wuting Road came
to the station and reported trivial injuries received at
the Mill gates when they were going to work at about

马克姆路381号鸿章棉纺厂工人罢工。

1936年10月10日上午11时，W.C.Seeds 先生及管理层代表按先前约定来到捕房，但等待被解雇的九名工人中只有两人出席。他们是：
1,- 余海清 (Yue Hai Ching)
2,- 袁阿妙 (Yuen Ah Miau)
他们声称自己并非作为其他人的代表而来，只是碰巧只有这两人出席。然而，显而易见的是，他们是有备而来，准备代表其他人。
向这两人解释说，通过代表媒介无法做任何事情，所有人必须同时出席。
随后他们离开捕房，并表示将安排所有人于1936年10月11日上午11时来到戈登路。
如日志第9页第1页所示，卞寿荣（Bei Tsung Yung）正由老闸捕房羁押，因此九人中只有八人能出席。
1936年10月10日上午11时05分，张兰增（Tsang Lai Tsung），女，19岁，住斐伦路935号，以及胡惠英（Woo Wei Ying），女，38岁，住吴淞路56号大德里，来到捕房，报告称在大约

10/1.

Strike of Workers in the Hung Chang Cotton Mill
at 301 Nanking Road.

Further to the remarks on diary No.9 re dismissal
of five other employees, enquiries have now revealed the
situation to be as follows:-

A letter was received from the Bureau of Social
Affairs by the Management on 8/10/36 translation as
follows:-

"Instructional Order issued by Bureau of Social
Affairs No.Character "Hai" 201.

"A petition has been received from the Preparatory
Committe of the No.3 Cotton Weaving workers Union to the
effect that two of the workers named Hoo Kung Zai and
Shu Vung Yah have been dismissed by the mill management
without any suitable reason, therefore a dispute between
the management and workers has commenced, and that this
Bureau be requested to take this case into consideration.

"According to the above, the declaration of
stoppage of work by the workers before negotiation or
decision by this Bureau is strictly prohibited and this
order has been repeatedly conveyed to every mill and
their workers. It is not according to "laws" of this
Bureau that the workers of the mill in question declare
a stoppage of work without first obtaining permission
from this Bureau, and is considered to be unreasonable".

（批：Noted f.a.d.b.
Alun 10/10）

南京路301号鸿章棉纺厂工人罢工。

继日志第9号关于另外五名雇员被解雇的备注之后，经调查，情况如下：-

管理层于1936年10月8日收到社会局的一封信，译文如下：-

“社会局发出的指令，编号‘海’字第201号。

“收到第三棉织工会筹备委员会的请愿书，称名为胡公仔（Hoo Kung Zai）和舒云亚（Shu Vung Yah）的两名工人被厂方无理由解雇，因此引发了管理层与工人之间的纠纷，请求本局考虑此案。

“据此，在本局谈判或裁决之前，工人宣布停工是被严格禁止的，此命令已反复传达给各工厂及其工人。涉事工厂的工人在未先获得本局许可的情况下宣布停工，不符合本局的‘法规’，被视为不合理”。

（批注：已知悉 f.a.d.b.
Alun 10/10）

"This Bureau, on receipt of this petition from the
workers Union, now again repeat the above order and
herewith instruct that all the workers of the mill
should resume work as soon as possible with a view
to maintaining order of the mill, with the exception
of the two dismissed members named Hoo Kung Zai and
Shu Vung Yah whose reason for their dismissal will be
investigated and the matter settled by negotiations
with the management later?

Prior to receipt of this letter the manage-
ment had decided on 7/10/36 to dismiss first, five
workers as shown on diary 9 page 1 and later, at the
first convenient opportunity, 4 others, (names below) for
being instrumental in prolonging the strike.

1. Bei Tsung Yung (卞春荣)。
2. Wong Ah Faung (王阿芳)。
3. Wong Yue Sung (王友生)。
4. Iung Ah Yung (尹阿荣)。

The letter (above) from Bureau of Social Affairs
temporarily
assents with the dismissal of the original two workers
but instructed that all other workers resume work.

The management on receipt of this letter realised
that to dismiss these further 9 men would be contrary
to the instructions of Bureau of Social Affairs.

After a discussion by the management it was

“本局在收到工会的这份请愿书后，现再次重申上述命令，并在此指示该厂所有工人应尽快恢复工作，以维持工厂秩序，除被解雇的两名成员胡公仔（Hoo Kung Zai）和舒云亚（Shu Vung Yah）外，他们的解雇原因将进行调查，此事稍后将通过与管理层谈判解决？

在收到此信之前，管理层已于1936年10月7日决定首先解雇日志第9页第1页所示的五名工人，随后在第一个方便的机会解雇另外四人（名单如下），原因是他们在延长罢工中起了作用。

2. 王阿芳 (Wong Ah Faung)。
3. 王友生 (Wong Yue Sung)。
4. 尹阿荣 (Iung Ah Yung)。

社会局的上述信件暂时
同意解雇最初的两名工人，但指示所有其他工人恢复工作。

管理层在收到此信后意识到，再解雇这九人将违背社会局的指示。

经管理层讨论后，

decided to adhere to their original decision and to

out cause for 3 consecutive days or, more than 6
days in one month;

Strike of Workers in the Hung Chang Cotton Mill
at 381 Markham Road.

At 5.10p.m. 9/10/36, a message was received
in the Charge Room from Hung Chang Mill to the effect
that workers were causing trouble at the mill.
    Inspt. i/c, D.S. White and party immediately
attended and found that F.S. Johnstone and C.D.S. 128
and party of police had 13 men under detention in the
Weaving Shed Dining Room.
    Enquiries revealed that these men, had entered
the Mill Compound with other workers, during change of
shifts and had assembled in the Mill Compound and demanded
to interview the management re reinstatement.
    Eight of the 13 workers were those already referred
to on Diary 9 page 2 and Diary 10 page 2, Bei Tsung Yung
being absent. The names of the other 5 are
    1,-Zee Vung Woo, 许文学       2,-Tsung Pau Ling, 東宝林
    3,-Ching Ling Hai, 秦林海     4,-Lieu Pao De, 刘宝弟
    5,-Tsung Ching Ling, 陳全林
    Also Mill workers on strike.
    The management refused to grant these men an inter-
view and they then went together to the Weaving Department
Dining Room and stated they intended to remain there
until an interview was granted.
    Whilst enquiries were in progress D.O. "B" attended
and the 13 workers were then taken to the office where

11.

马克姆路381号鸿章纱厂工人罢工。

1936年10月9日下午5时10分，警署值班室收到来自鸿章纱厂的消息，称厂内工人正在滋事。
    负责督察 D.S. White 及其随行人员立即赶赴现场，发现 F.S. Johnstone 和刑事侦缉处第128号探员及其警队已在织布车间食堂扣留了13人。
    经查询得知，这些人在换班期间与其他工人一同进入厂区，并在厂区内聚集，要求与管理方面谈复职事宜。
    这13名工人中有8人已在第9号日志第2页和第10号日志第2页中提及，其中 Bei Tsung Yung 缺席。其余5人的姓名如下：
    1,-Zee Vung Woo, 许文学       2,-Tsung Pau Ling, 東宝林
    3,-Ching Ling Hai, 秦林海     4,-Lieu Pao De, 刘宝弟
    5,-Tsung Ching Ling, 陳全林
    这些人也是参与罢工的工厂工人。
    管理方拒绝与这些人面谈，随后他们一同前往织布部食堂，并表示在获准面谈之前将一直留在那里。
    在调查进行期间，“B”分区警官到场，随后这13名工人被带往办公室，在那里

page_data.en:
Political 14/36.
11/2.

D.O. "B", Inspt. i/c, the manager and D.S. White
discussed the matter.
It must be noted that the nine men have not yet
been properly notified of their dismissal, but as shown
on Diary No. 9 page 2 (last para.), four of these men
had been refused admittance to the mill at 6a.m. 9/10/36
when they wished to resume work.
These workers stated they had the authority of the
Bureau of Social affairs, to again start work, in the
form of a letter. This was not displayed but is believed
to be one identical with that received by the management.
This letter is said to be in the possession of Hoo Kung
Zeu (何根傳) (one of the original two dismissed).
It was finally arranged, with the sanction of
D.O."B", that these workers and a representative of the
management, meet at Gordon Road Station at 11a.m.
10/10/36 when the findings of a meeting to be arranged
by Mr. W.C. Seeds with the management in the interim,
will be conveyed to them.
The increase in the number of strikers shown on
Diary 10 page 3 (night shift) is most probably, due to
the fact that some workers arriving for the night shift,
would not enter the Mill Compound on observing that some
trouble was afoot and were seen to walk away (most
probably returning to their homes).
page_data.zh:
政治类 14/36。
11/2。

“B”分区警官、负责督察、经理和 D.S. White 讨论了此事。
必须指出，这九人尚未收到正式的解雇通知，但如第9号日志第2页（最后一段）所示，其中四人在1936年10月9日上午6点希望复工时被拒绝进入工厂。
这些工人声称，他们持有社会局授权其重新工作的信件。该信件未出示，但据信与管理方收到的信件相同。据说这封信由 Hoo Kung Zeu (何根傳)（最初被解雇的两人之一）持有。
最终在“B”分区警官的批准下达成协议，这些工人与一名管理方代表将于1936年10月10日上午11点在戈登路巡捕房会面，届时将向他们传达 W.C. Seeds 先生在此期间安排与管理方会议的结果。
第10号日志第3页（夜班）显示的罢工人数增加，很可能是因为一些来上夜班的工人看到有麻烦发生，便不愿进入厂区，被人看到步行离开（很可能是回家了）。

page_data.en:
Political 14/36.

11/3.

No holiday is being observed by the Mill on
10/10/36 (Double Tenth) in view of the present unrest
and the probability of the management deciding to
"close down" until the workers are willing to return.

(签名)
D. S. E.

鉴于目前的动荡局势以及管理方可能决定在工人愿意返回之前“关闭”工厂，该厂在1936年10月10日（双十节）不放假。

This information was not passed to detectives until

It is learnt that the Bureau of Social Affairs
has already sent a letter to the workers representatives
instructing them to resume work first and to negotiate
afterwards. These instructions however were based on the
original grievance of the two dismissed workers.
The dismissal of the above five has further com-
plicated matters but as this information only came

1936年10月7日，管理方决定解雇以下五名男工，因为已知他们是积极延长罢工的人：-

这一信息直到刑事侦缉处第202号探员从外部获悉并直接询问管理方后才传递给侦探。

上述五人的解雇使事态进一步复杂化，但由于这一信息直到1936年10月9日上午7点才到手，相关的调查尚未完成。

Labour

Hung Tsang Cotton Mill - strike situation

In connection with the dispute between the workers
and the management of the Hung Tsang Cotton Mill, 381
Markham Road, over the dismissal of two workers for
organizing a labour union (Vide I.R.2/10/36), 188 of the
850 night shift workers did not report for work on the
night of October 6/7, and 170 of the day shift workers
absented themselves from duty this morning, October 7.

Tseng Yuan Silk Factory - reduction in working period

With effect from October 6, the Tseng Yuan Silk
Factory, 19 Teh Loong Fang, Brenan Road, O.J.L., reduced
its working period to six days a week owing to the present
local situation, and the fifty-two workers in its employ
have been divided into two shifts each operating three
days a week. This factory hitherto operated six days and
six nights a week.

Shanghai Citizens' Association - annual meeting

Between 5.p.m. and 8 p.m. October 6, the annual meeting
of the Shanghai Citizens' Association was held in its office,
Room 415 Chung Wei Building, 16 Rue de la Porte du Nord,
with 90 members attending.

Strike of workers in the Hung Chang Cotton Mill
at 361 Markham Road. 鴻章紗廠

Further enquiries at the above mill on the night
of the 5/10/36 ascertained that 230 workers of the night
shift failed to report for work.

The position to date is now as follows;- 160 day-
shift workers and 230 night-shift workers have failed to
report for work, a total of 390 male and females. This
is probably explained by the fact that on Sunday, 4/10/36,
the mill is closed down during the period of the day-shift,
6 a.m. to 6 p.m. and this would therefore afford an opportu-
-nity to the disgruntled workers to circulate amongst the
other workers for the purpose of spreading discontent.
It was learnt that many of the workers who are unwilling
to strike were approached on Sunday, 4/10/36, and requested
to help the strikers by refusing to resume work for two
days, thereby assisting them, the strikers, to gain their
objective.

With regard to the notice posted by the management
to the effect that in the event of the strikers failing
to resume work in two days, all would be dismissed, Mr.
Ts Hai Tsong informed the undersigned to the effect that
this notice was posted more as a means to frighten the
workers into resuming, and should not be taken too literally
but at the same time, should the situation assume serious

Local situation - decrease in the number of residents

The exodus of persons from Chinese controlled territory
(Vide I.R.2/10/36) showed a decided decrease on October 2.
Although thepanic in Chapei appears to have subsided,
rumours are still rife concerning impending Sino-Japanese
hostilities. The barricades erected by the Japanese
Naval Landing Party in Hongkew District have now been
removed.

Labour

Jen Yue Hosiery Factory - suspends operations

The Jen Yue Hosiery Factory, 53 Singapore Road, O.O.L.
closed on October 2 owing to lack of business. As a result,
300 workers are affected.

Hung Tsang Cotton Mill - strike situation

One hundred and ninety of the 850 night shift hands
employed by the Hung Tsang Cotton Mill, 381 Markham Road,
absented themselves from duty on the night of October 2/3.
Of the 270 day shift workers who went on strike on October 1
(Vide I.R.2/10/36), 170 returned to work this morning,
while the remaining 100 employees are still out.

The dismissal of two workers on September 28 for .
organizing a labour union is the cause of the agitation
among these workers.

At 8.30a.m. on 2/10/36, the undersigned again
visited the manager of the Hung Chang Mill (鴻章紗廠)
when it was learnt that out of the normal complement

The remainder, 377 female and male workers,
proceeded quietly to the various departments where they
remained at work without any sign of demonstration.
During the interview, Mr. Ts Hai Tsong informed
the undersigned that he had received information from
one of his department foremen, to the effect that cases
of intimidation had occurred at the following places
between the hours of 5a.m. to 6.30a.m. and 5p.m. to
6.30p.m. on 1/10/36 and 2/10/36;-
(1) Markham and Connaught Roads corner,
(2) Changping Road near Markham Road, and
(3) Markham Li off Markham Road
on the part of disgruntled employees, now on strike.
Inspector i/c informed and police on beat duty in
the vicinity of the above places have been warned to keep
a sharp look out.
Detectives have also been detailed for observation
in regard to the above.

1936年10月2日上午8时30分，签署人再次拜访了鸿章纱厂（鴻章紗廠）经理，获悉在正常的日班工人编制（男女共657人）中，有240名女工和40名男工（共计280人）未在1936年10月2日上午到岗上班。
其余377名男女工人安静地前往各个部门，继续工作，没有任何示威迹象。
在会谈期间，蔡海宗先生告知签署人，他从一名车间领班处获得消息，称在1936年10月1日和10月2日的上午5时至6时30分以及下午5时至6时30分之间，以下地点发生了不满员工（现正罢工）实施的恐吓案件：
(1) 马克姆路与康纳脱路转角，
(2) 靠近马克姆路的昌平路，以及
(3) 马克姆路旁的马克姆里
负责督察已获知此事，并在上述地点附近巡逻的警察已接到警告，需保持高度警惕。
侦探也已受命针对上述情况进行监视。

At 6p.m. on 2/10/36, when the night shift comprising
660 hands should have reported for work, it was found
that 460 only, checked in, or less 200. This now makes
a total of 480 male and female workers on strike.
It is thought by the management, that it is only
a matter of time before the entire complement of workers
will have ceased work.
Up to date, enquiries show, no representations
have been made by the workers to the management.
Mr. Ts Hai Tsong assured the undersigned that
every effort to bring the dispute to an early settlement
would be made by the management, but that, in the event
of any further demands, such as increased wages, or the
like, being put forth by the workers, a complete "shut-
out" would be ordered for an indefinite period. (Mr. Ts
Hai Tsong has apparently heard rumours to the effect
that higher wages would also be demanded by the workers,
during the present dispute).
Strict observation is being kept up, and a further
report will be forwarded in due course.

Strike of Workers in the Hung Chang Cotton

At 11.00a.m. on 1/10/36, the undersigned again
visited the Secretary of the Board of Directors of the
above Mill, at 381 Markham Road when it was learnt that
no definite decision had been arrived at between the
management and the workers, but that all hands were working
normally as hitherto, with no suspicion of impending
disturbance.

At 2.00p.m. same date, the undersigned was informed
by Mr. Ts Hai Tsong (The Secretary referred to above) to
the effect that he had received definite instructions to
dismiss the two workmen, (referred to on Diary 1) despite
any adverse action on the part of the other workers, and
that he would dismiss these men at 3.00p.m. even date.

He further informed the undersigned to the effect
that he had received information from his foreman named
Zung Tsung Chang (鄭鎮昌 ) revealing the possibility of
a disturbance staged by the friends of the men whom he
intended to dismiss, he therefore requested police
protection on the premises, in view of this. The foreman
when questioned stated that he had himself heard muttered
threats on the part of many of the workers, in the mill,
to the effect that the management "would be sorry" if they
persisted in the dismissal of their two friends, (1) Hoo
Kung Zeu (何根傳 ) and (2) Shu Vung Yah (許文學 )

马克姆路381号鸿章纱厂工人罢工。（鴻章紗廠）

1936年10月1日上午11时，签署人再次拜访了上述纱厂位于马克姆路381号的董事会秘书，获悉资方与工人之间尚未达成明确决定，但所有工人均像以往一样正常工作，没有即将发生骚乱的迹象。

同日（10月1日）下午2时，签署人接到蔡海宗先生（上述秘书）的通知，称他已收到明确指示，要解雇两名工人（参见日志1），不管其他工人采取何种不利行动，他将在同日（10月1日）下午3时解雇这些人。

他还进一步告知签署人，他从名为郑镇昌 (鄭鎮昌 ) 的领班处获得消息，透露被他打算解雇的工人的朋友可能会制造骚乱，因此他请求警方在现场提供保护。经询问，该领班表示，他本人在纱厂内听到许多工人低声威胁，称如果资方坚持解雇他们的两位朋友，(1) 何根傳 (Hoo Kung Zeu) 和 (2) 许文学 (Shu Vung Yah)，资方“会后悔的”。

（批：S. 2）
（批：LH 10月2日）
（批：归档）

page_data.en:
Political 14/36.

3/2.

A party of police under Inspector Holt, Officer i/c
immediately proceeded to the mill, and shortly afterwards
"Hoo Kung Zeu" was called from the mill by the manager,
who told him his services were no longer required. He was
immediately paid his salary, to date, and left the premises
quickly.

This man was engaged on day-shift whilst his friend,
Shu Vung Yoh is employed on the night shift.

Mr. Ts Hai Tsong then stated that at 6p.m. upon
the arrival of Shu Vung Yoh, he was also to be paid off.

As no signs of a disturbance were apparent, police
were withdrawn except for the usual strength which has
kept observation during the past few days.

At 6p.m. the undersigned was again present, but
Shu Vung Yoh failed to arrive at the mill for work.

From this it is considered that he had met and
been informed by his friend of the decision of the manage-
ment, and consequently has remained away probably to
consider some other line of action, after consulting with
his friends.

At present, no useful information regarding the
type of reaction to be expected from the workers, when they
all learn of the dismissal of these two men, could be obtain
-ed, apart from rumours to the effect that a strike would

（批：Full night shift reported for work with exception of Shu Vung Yoh. A.）
page_data.zh:

3/2。

由霍尔特督察率领的一队警察（负责警官）立即前往纱厂，不久后，经理将“何根傳”叫出纱厂，告诉他不再需要他的服务。他立即结清了截至当日的薪水，并迅速离开了现场。

此人是白班工人，而他的朋友许文学 (Shu Vung Yoh) 则是夜班工人。

蔡海宗先生随后表示，下午6时许文学到达时，也将被解雇并结清工资。

由于没有出现骚乱的迹象，除过去几天一直进行监视的常规警力外，其他警察已撤离。

下午6时，签署人再次到场，但许文学未到纱厂上班。

由此认为，他已与其朋友见面并得知了资方的决定，因此可能在与朋友商议后，为了考虑其他行动方案而缺席。

目前，除了有关将举行罢工的谣言外，无法获得关于当工人们得知这两人被解雇后预期会有何种反应的任何有用信息，

（批：除许文学外，全班夜班工人均报到上班。A.）

Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company - increase in daily working
period
The Thorburn Road Factory and the Pootung Factory of
the Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company commenced operating ten
hours instead of nine hours a day on October 1.

Hung Tsang Cotton Mill - day shift workers declare
strike
On the morning of October 1, 270 of the 850 day
shift workers of the Hung Tsang Cotton Mill declared a
strike as a protest against the action of the management
in dismissing two workers on September 28 for being the
organizers of a labour union (Vide I.R. 29/9/36).
The 850 night shift workers who declared a strike
for the same reason at 6 p.m., September 28, resumed
unconditionally on the evening of September 29.

Asia Steel Factory - workers cease agitation
In connection with the demand of the workers of
the Asia Steel Factory, 379 Hochien Road, for an increase
in wages (Vide I.R. 1/10/36), the management has agreed
to grant them a wage increase ranging from 3 to 6 cents
per day with effect from October 1. Ten of the fifteen
workers who walked out on October 1 in order to enforce
the demand in question have been dismissed. A decision
regarding the remaining five workers will be given on
October 3.

颐中烟草公司的索恩伯里路工厂和浦东工厂自10月1日起，每天工作十小时，而非九小时。

关于合信路379号亚细亚钢铁厂工人要求增加工资一事（参见1936年10月1日情报报告），资方已同意自10月1日起，每天给他们增加3至6分的工资。为了强制执行上述要求而在10月1日罢工的15名工人中，有10人已被解雇。关于其余5名工人的决定将于10月3日公布。

This factory employs a complement of 60 hands, and

divided them into two shifts to operate alternate days.
It is learned that the management intends to dismiss

5th District Cigarette Factory Workers' Union
- activities.

In commemoration of the anniversary of the strike
of the Yee Tsoong Tobacco Factory workers following which
the management of the concern agreed to pay taxes on
tobacco to the Chinese Government, the 5th District
Cigarette Factory Workers' Union, 78 Lan Nyi Doo Road,

anniversary were pasted on the walls of the Union premises

Arrangements are being made by workers of the
Hung Tsang Cotton Mill, 381 Markham Road, to form a
union and a preparatory office has been established at
No.20 Zoong Teh Li (崇德里), Heng Foong Road, Chapei.

Machine Shop of the Mill.
The Hung Tsang Cotton Mill employs a total of

为纪念颐中烟草厂工人罢工周年（此后该公司资方同意向中国政府缴纳烟草税），位于浦东兰尼杜路78号的第五区卷烟厂工人联合会于9月30日下午5时至6时举行会议，80人出席。印有周年纪念内容的海报于9月29日张贴在联合会办公处的墙壁上。

鸿章纱厂 - 工人组建工会

马克姆路381号鸿章纱厂的工人正在安排组建工会，并在闸北恒丰路崇德里20号设立了筹备办公室。
该运动的发起人是该厂机器间的领班许文学 (Hsu Wen-yah) 和何根才 (Ho Keng-zai)。

September 29, 1936.

-2-

Hung Tsang Cotton Mill - strike

At 6 p.m. September 28, the night shift workers of
the Hung Tsang Cotton Mill, 381 Markham Road, went on a
strike with a view to demanding the reinstatement of two
labourers who were dismissed by the management on suspicion
of being actively engaged in organizing a labour union.

The management has promised to reinstate the two
workers for the time being pending a decision by the Board
of Directors.

This mill has a total complement of 1,700 workers, of
whom 850 are employed on night shift.

The day shift workers are operating as usual, and
it is expected that the night shift workers will return
to work this evening.

Cathay Laundry - strike continues

The fifty workers employed in the Ironing Department
of the Cathay Laundry, 1178 Pingliang Road, continue on
strike this morning, Sept.29 to enforce their demand for
the reinstatement of a dismissed worker(vide I.R.28/9/36).

Workers in other departments are operating as usual.

Miscellaneous

1st Special District Citizens' Federation - circular to
shop owners

On Sept. 28, the 1st Special District Citizens' Federation
Chinese Chamber of Commerce Building, North Soochow Road,
issued a circular notice to various shop owners in the
Settlement asking them to hoist flags on Oct. 1 in celebration
of the renaming of Thibet Road as Yu Yah Ching Road. The
notice also requests them to send representatives to attend

鸿章纱厂 - 罢工

9月28日下午6时，位于马克姆路（Markham Road）381号的鸿章纱厂夜班工人举行罢工，旨在要求资方复职两名被管理层因涉嫌积极组织工会而解雇的劳工。

管理层已承诺暂时复职这两名工人，待董事会作出决定后再行定夺。

该厂共有员工1,700人，其中850人为夜班工人。

白班工人照常作业，预计夜班工人将于今晚复工。

国泰洗衣房 - 罢工持续

位于平凉路1178号的国泰洗衣房熨烫部的五十名工人，于今晨（9月29日）继续罢工，以强制要求复职一名被解雇的工人（参见 I.R. 1936年9月28日报告）。

其他部门的工人照常作业。

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

Strike at Hung Chang Cotton Spinning, Weaving and Dyeing Factory, 381 Markham Road.

At 7.20p.m. on 28/9/36, a telephone message was received from one named Ling Wen Ts (林文書 ) office clerk, employed by the Hung Chang Cotton Spinning, Weaving and Dyeing Factory, (鴻章紗廠 ) situated at No. 381 Markham road to the effect that a strike had occurred in the above factory affecting about 850 workers, further adding that the strikers were on the premises and refused to leave.

Inspector Holt, Officer i/c District, D.S. Taylor, and a party of police immediately proceeded to the scene when it was learnt that the night and day shifts of male and female workers of the Spinning and Weaving departments of the above factory, comprising about 850 workers in all had ceased work, and definitely refused to continue until the following two demands had been complied with by the management;-

(1) That the workers be allowed to establish a branch of the 3rd District Cotton Weaving Labourers Union, (Located on Hung Roong Road, Chapei).

(2) That two workers named (1) Shu Vung Yoh (許文榮 ) and (2) Huo Kung Zeu (何根傳 ) dismissed by a foreman named Zung Tsung Chang (鄭鎮昌 ) at 6p.m. on 28/9/36 be reinstated.
