位于马克姆路381号的鸿章纺织印染厂罢工。

1936年9月28日晚上7时20分，接到一名名为林文書 (Ling Wen Ts) 的电话留言，此人是位于马克姆路381号的鸿章纱厂 (Hung Chang Cotton Spinning, Weaving and Dyeing Factory) 的职员，称上述工厂发生罢工，涉及约850名工人，并补充说罢工者仍在厂区内，拒绝离开。

辖区负责人霍尔特巡官 (Inspector Holt)、泰勒警探长 (D.S. Taylor) 及一队警员立即赶赴现场，届时获悉上述工厂纺纱部和织布部的男女日夜班工人，共计约850人，已停止工作，并明确拒绝继续工作，除非资方满足以下两项要求：-

(1) 允许工人建立第三区棉纺织业工会分会，（位于闸北鸿荣路）。

(2) 复职两名工人，即 (1) 许文榮 (Shu Vung Yoh) 和 (2) 何根傳 (Huo Kung Zeu)，此二人于1936年9月28日下午6时被一名名为郑镇昌 (Zung Tsung Chang) 的工头解雇。

（批注：档案 4/1）
（批注：M 29/9 Unn）

page_data.en:
Political 14/36.

1/2.

Mr. Ts Hai Tsong (施洪章) Secretary of the Board
of Directors of the concern was communicated with, and,
upon his arrival the following was learnt;- On the
25/9/36, representation was made to the management by
the two now dismissed workmen, who apparently acting as
spokesmen on behalf of the Spinning and Weaving Depart-
ments, demanded that the workers be allowed to establish
a branch office of the 3rd District Spinning and Weaving
Labour Union, and to become affiliated to that union.
Mr. Ts Hai Tsong then explained to them that the idea
would not be entertained by the management; Later in an
effort to arrest the movement before same had a chance to
take root, (but only after enquiries had been made amongst
the workers by the management, resulting in information
being received to the effect that "Shu Vung Yoh" and
"Hoo Kung Zeu" were likely to cause discontent amongst
the staff) the two above named workers representatives
were informed to the effect that their services would
terminate on 28/9/36.

This resulted in a committee being formed, compris-
ing 8 male workers (named hereunder) (1) Yee Hai Ching
(余海卿) (2) Loh San Pao (陸三寶) (3) Zee Pao Ching
(徐寶青) (4) Zung Lan Sung (鄭蘭生) (5) Hoo Ah Sung
(賀安生) (6) Tan Kung Dau (談根道) (7) Wong Ah Sung
(王阿生) (8) Wong Yeu Dau (王有生) who presented
page_data.zh:
政治类 14/36。

1/2.

与该商号董事会秘书施洪章 (Mr. Ts Hai Tsong) 取得联系，在其到达后获悉如下情况：- 1936年9月25日，现已被解雇的两名工人向管理层提出交涉，他们显然作为纺纱和织布部门的代言人，要求允许工人建立第三区纺织业工会分会，并加入该工会。施洪章先生随后向他们解释，管理层不会考虑这一想法；后来，为了在该运动有机会扎根之前予以遏制（但仅在管理层对工人进行调查之后，获悉“许文榮”和“何根傳”可能会在员工中引起不满），上述两名工人代表被告知，他们的雇佣关系将于1936年9月28日终止。

这导致成立了一个委员会，由8名男工组成（名字如下）(1) 余海卿 (Yee Hai Ching) (2) 陆三寶 (Loh San Pao) (3) 徐寶青 (Zee Pao Ching) (4) 郑蘭生 (Zung Lan Sung) (5) 贺安生 (Hoo Ah Sung) (6) 谈根道 (Tan Kung Dau) (7) 王阿生 (Wong Ah Sung) (8) 王有生 (Wong Yeu Dau)，他们提出了

page_data.en:
Political 14/36.

1/3.

the above two demands to the management at about 6.30p.m.
on 28/9/36, in the meantime a halt was called which
affected the departments mentioned above .

It was also learnt that the two dismissed workers
had applied for registration to the Bureau of Social
Affairs, Nantao on about 20/9/36, with a view to obtaining
recognition of their proposal to establish a union.

Following a lengthy discussion in the factory from
7.30p.m. to 9p.m. 28/9/36, a local agreement was arrived
at between the Secretary, Mr. Ts Hai Tsong and the workers
to the effect that the two dismissed workmen may continue
their work from a.m. 29/9/36, provided all hands turned
in together. This was agreed to, as a form of temporary
measure, pending a meeting of the management at about
4p.m. on 29/9/36, at which time, representatives of the
workers would be present to discuss the situation.

Only about 100 of the night shift remained behind
to work, the remainder leaving the factory, without
causing disturbance, promising to continue work from the
29/9/36, pending settlement of the affair.

The situation up to the present cannot be described
as normal, especially in view of the unlikelihood ,
(according to Mr. Ts Hai Tsong) of the management agreeing
to the workers demands.

Police have therefore been posted in the vicinity
page_data.zh:
政治类 14/36。

1/3.

上述两项要求给管理层，时间约为1936年9月28日下午6时30分，与此同时，上述部门停工。

还获悉，这两名被解雇的工人曾于1936年9月20日左右向南市社会局申请注册，以期获得对其建立工会提议的认可。

经过1936年9月28日晚上7时30分至9时在工厂内的长时间讨论，秘书施洪章先生与工人达成了一项局部协议，规定只要全体人员一起复工，这两名被解雇的工人可以从1936年9月29日上午起继续工作。作为一种临时措施，双方同意了这一点，等待资方于1936年9月29日下午4时左右召开会议，届时工人代表将出席讨论局势。

只有约100名夜班工人留下工作，其余人离开工厂，未造成骚乱，并承诺在事件解决之前，从1936年9月29日起继续工作。

截至目前，局势不能描述为正常，特别是鉴于（据施洪章先生称）资方不太可能同意工人的要求。

因此，警方已在附近部署警力

page_data.en:
Political 14/36.

1/4.

and observation of the movements of the workers is
being kept up by detectives, pending the outcome of the
discussion between both parties, at 4p.m. 29/9/56, the
result of which will be the subject of a further report.
There is no suggestion of, or threatened, distur-
bance, up to the present.

Senior Detective i/c.

D. S. 201.

Special Branch.

1/4.

并由警探持续观察工人的动向，等待双方于1936年9月29日下午4时讨论的结果，其结果将成为进一步报告的主题。
截至目前，没有发生或威胁发生骚乱的迹象。

负责高级警探。
